articleTitle: Implementation of In-memory Wallace-Tree Multiplier using Hybrid Majority-gates
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In-memory computing with contemporary technologies like resistive-RAM (Re-RAM) provides a possible solution to the ‘von-Neumann bottleneck,’ driving current research efforts to circumvent the memory wall. Recently, various approaches have been devised to implement logics like Boolean within memory, traditional arithmetic circuits such as multipliers and adders and often require significant hardware resources when implemented Boolean operations as series. This work addresses the challenge by adopting the Wallace-Tree multiplier architecture and addition process in every phase of the Wallace-Tree has been optimized. The usage of logic of majority for addition has advantages over NAND, NOR, and IMPLY primitives. Additionally, executing numerous majority-gates (MG) within the array columns results in substantial gate-level parallelism. The approach of using hybrid MG results in a lower area footprint, outperforming all previously reported in-memory multipliers regarding efficiency of area. Moreover, the multiplier proposed with minimal modifications to its peripheral circuitry can be implemented in a standard transistor accessed memory array, making it both area and energy efficient.

articleTitle: CCN - Based Melanoma Anamoly Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Skin issues are a global health concern as they are impacted by both heredity and the environment. Skin cancer has a high fatality rate, although it is curable with simple surgery if caught early enough. Nevertheless, the present diagnostic techniques are laborious to process and yield inaccurate findings. With an accuracy of $\mathbf{6 0 - 8 0 \%}$, high-speed cameras show promise. By precisely identifying and classifying skin cancer lesions as either malignant or non-malignant, this study seeks to expedite the analysis of these lesions for the benefit of both patients and medical experts. Higher diagnostic efficiency in deep learning is provided by convolutional neural networks (CNNs). To improve the assessment of skin cancer, we propose CNNs. CNN uses standardized datasets to diagnose various types of skin cancer. The accuracy of the model was about $\mathbf{9 8. 6. 7 \%}$. The model demonstrate how deep learning can help achieve the goal.

articleTitle: Intravenous Saline Monitoring System Powered by IoT for Patient Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In past few years, the healthcare business has evolved rapidly by guaranteeing that hospitalized patients recover swiftly. Hospitalized patients require proper care, surveillance, and timely nutrition supply. The demand for health prevention is increasing as the world’s population grows. All hospitals must exercise caution as this industry’s staff grows. There the idea of implementing automatic saline monitoring system including patient safety need to be developed. Saline is widely used in hospitals to treat patients who are dehydrated or suffering from various medical ailments. The suggested system includes a sensor that monitors the crucial amount of saline liquid in the bottle, displays saline and patients’ information in nurse room additional to this some necessary sensors are used for knowing patient information and buzzer for indication in any problematic cases. The device was tested after completing the necessary hardware development. The outcome was satisfactory, indicating that there could be improved patient care.

articleTitle: Predicting Reservoir Resource Utilization Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The key issues in Reservoir Usage are the Computation of Reservoir Storage and Prediction of Water Levels using Machine Learning. The research integrates complex underground water techniques with AI to forecast water level trends in related reservoirs. and the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, including Bayesian Networks (BN), Decision Trees (DT), k-nearest Neighbors (kNN), and Support Vector Machines (SVM), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Rule-Based optimization, Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTM) for handling heterogeneous data to provide solutions. Quantifying reservoir operations is an essential process for the efficient management of water resources. Water level records are often the only data available for reservoir operation analysis, which causes an ill-posed problem in water resource system planning. This study proposes a framework to estimate reservoir operations using machine learning models and reasoning carefully derived from expert knowledge and soft data.

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) and IoT-optimized Heterogeneous Broad Transmission Distance Protocol (HT-BTDP)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Numerous cluster applications connect wireless sensor networks to the internet of things, and one of these steps is energy efficient clustering. Failure to account for clustering or heterogeneity makes evaluating a network’s lifespan a difficult undertaking. Various techniques for energy-efficient clustering have been developed using models of the cluster head selection. Massive effort is required to model WSN-IoT full clustering. Part of the clusters system that is not discussed here is the stability phase and network lifespan. Clustering WSN-IoTs with an emphasis on heterogeneity and then scalability is the major goal of this study. Additionally, the presentation includes the specifics of the live metrics that are used for comparing the energy-efficient clustering methods across different time intervals. Prior to developing our first heterogeneous wide transmission distance protocol (HT-BTDP), we devote most of our attention to the selection of cluster heads. These results prove that the proposed HT-BTDP algorithm increases the stability period and lifespan in all analysed cases relative to SEP and EEHC. From the result, it can be observed that for the same vocabulary size the algorithm is on the higher side than SEP as well as EEHC. Further, in average the stability time is increased by $\mathbf{9 8. 2 4 \%}$ in the effectiveness time. While comparing with SEP, that is HIT, the efficacy is $59 \%$ and while comparing with TLE, that is LIT, the efficacy is $14 \%.84 \%$ when compared to EEHC. Also, to SEP, the average life span is 15 years. This makes it $77 \%$ longer, and compared to EEHC, it is 13.

articleTitle: Weather Prediction Model using Ridge Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Weather prediction is crucial for various sectors such as agriculture, transportation, and disaster management. Accurate forecasts enable proactive measures to mitigate risks and optimize operations. Traditional methods rely on complex numerical models, while machine learning (ML) offers a promising alternative due to its ability to provide accurate predictions with less computational overhead. This study focuses on predicting the next day’s maximum temperature using ridge regression models applied to historical weather data from Bangalore, India. The research emphasizes feature engineering techniques to enhance model performance, including the creation of rolling window statistics and expanding averages of temperature data. The linear regression model is replaced with ridge regression due to its capability to handle multicollinearity and overfitting issues. Evaluation metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Error (MSE), and R-squared ($\mathbf{R}^{2}$) are employed to assess model accuracy. The results demonstrate that the ridge regression model achieves promising accuracy in predicting daily maximum temperatures. This paper discusses the methodology, experiments, and results in detail, highlighting the model’s performance.

articleTitle: Investigations on Microgrid based Photovoltaic and Wind Energy Systems in Standalone mode
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This paper presents the Standalone Microgrid system configuration i.e., incorporation of renewable energy sources - Solar and Wind has implemented in Matlab/Simulink platform. The goal is to unlimits the utilization rate by reducing the operation expenses over the lifecycle and by maintaining the power supply reliability. The mathematical modelling of the Solar and Wind energy systems is developed to predict their performance under various environmental conditions. DC/DC Bi-directional converter-based Battery considered as backup energy source for reliable the power supply. Further, an L filter is employed to reduce the harmonics. To achieve the MPPT of Solar, RBFNN is proposed. This technique enhances the adaptability and accuracy of MPPT in fluctuating conditions. The system performance is evaluated through simulation results. The proposed system demonstrates significant improvement for power system balancing condition and stability in terms of mitigation harmonics, current THDs in limits, validating the effectiveness of the system with the above advanced technique.

Author Keywords: Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) technique

articleTitle: A Compact Dual-Element MIMO Antenna withT-Shaped Ground Plane for mm-Wave 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The proposed study introduces a compact MIMO antenna system featuring two elements. The structure has a very less size of $43 \times 34.9 \mathbf{~ m m}^{2}$ and incorporates a T-shaped ground plane, which provides a low impedance path to ground for RF signals. It is mounted on an FR4 substrate with Er= 4.4. The designed antenna operates in the frequency range of 11.8 GHz to 16 GHz, making it suitable for 5 G applications. The antenna’s performance was designed and analyzed using Ansoft HFSS 13.0 software, with calculations specifically performed for a frequency of 15 GHz. The designed MIMO antenna achieves a return loss of $\mathbf{-3 3. 5 6} \mathrm{dB}$ and a maximum gain at 15 GHz. Additionally, the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) of the designed antenna is 1.04.

articleTitle: Cardiac Arrhythmia Classification using Ensemble Machine Learning Algorithms with PPG and ECG signals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In this study, machine learning calculations such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Logistic Regression, and Random Forest are explored to classify cardiac arrhythmias utilizing Electrocardiogram (ECG) and Photoplethysmogram (PPG) signals. The aim is to create models that not only precisely identify peaks but also analyze cardiac arrhythmias, thereby improving the management of cardiovascular disorders. A thorough literature review was conducted to determine the best approach to treat ECG and PPG signals, leading to the design of calculations to differentiate R-peaks from ECG signals and other waveforms from PPG signals. A comparison study involving four models found that Random Forest and Logistic Regression performed significantly better than the other models.

articleTitle: Conditional Autoregressive-Salp Swarm Algorithm with Differential Pulse Code Modulation for Efficient Block-based Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: If a signal is compressible or sparse in a particular base representation, one of the most effective ways to minimize its dimensions is to use compressed sensing in a video streaming application. The sparse representation is a good approximation to the signal since the amplitude of the coefficient’s decays according to the power law. Transmitting signals into a space with few dimensions allows them to be transformed into measurement vectors. It is possible to reassemble a sparse signal with high precision using the measurement vector. Imprecise or sparse yet compressible signal or noise that could result in an approximation. Waveletor frequency-domain images are well-suited for Compressed Sensing because of their inherent compressibility. With a smaller compression ratio—the ratio of an original picture’s pixel size to its measurement vector—and an development in the superiority of the rebuilt image, the modernization is now more accurate. In order to improve the compressed video streaming system, this technique proposes an optimum mechanism that integrates the use of DPCM with the Provisional Autoregressive-Salp Swarm system. Through careful frame segmentation, the approach investigates the spatial redundancy of individual video frames. At this stage, we quantify the resulting vectors by applying DPCM after measuring each block using a dimension matrix.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Cataract Detection Using Fundus and Real-Time Naked Eye Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Cataracts are the most common eye disease and the leading cause of blindness worldwide. The eye ailment known as cataracts results in clouded lenses, leading to vision that appears foggy or frosted. People with cataracts often struggle with tasks like reading, driving, or recognizing faces due to the impaired clarity of their vision. Effective treatment and prevention of vision loss depend on the early detection of cataracts. The proposed system is a deep learning-based approach to detect cataracts from the naked eye and fundus images that can help ophthalmologists diagnose cataracts earlier, more accurately, and efficiently. Both fundus and naked eye images are processed by the system to detect cataracts. The system offers a dependable and automated solution for cataract detection, enabling timely diagnosis and treatment. Its performance is on par with that of ophthalmologists, highlighting its potential as an effective and trustworthy tool for automated cataract detection. The proposed model employs two distinct deep learning approaches. For identifying cataracts using naked eye images, a standard CNN architecture was utilized, achieving an accuracy of 94.26%. For detecting cataracts in fundus eye images, a Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) with the VGG19 architecture was implemented, demonstrating a notable accuracy of 96.78%. This model holds substantial promise, offering a non-invasive and accessible method for cataract screening. It is particularly helpful in environments with limited resources, where access to expert eye care is frequently limited.

articleTitle: An Approach Towards Real-Time Arrhythmia Detection using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Arrhythmia refers to any abnormality in the heart’s electrical activity that disrupts its regular rhythm. In the absence of prompt detection and treatment, arrhythmias can cause serious health complications. An Arrhythmia Detection System has been developed as a real-time healthcare application designed to detect and classify arrhythmias in patients. The proposed method uses Kafka for real-time data streaming to get the data from devices directly and applies deep learning techniques like LSTM for analysing electrocardiograms and classifying the readings as “normal” or “abnormal” near to real time. The developed model is also compared with various existing works including Arrhythmia detection using CNN, SVM. Data Streaming for near to real time prediction with high accuracy is the novelty achieved for the current work.

Author Keywords: Near to Real Time Arrhythmia Detection

articleTitle: Comparison of Five-level and Seven-level Multi-Level Inverters Designed with Fewer Switches and less Voltage Stress
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Multi-level inverters used for single-phase applications requires more quantity of power switches as the inverter voltage level at the output increases. The increase in number of devices affects inverter size, increases the cost, increases the complication of generating firing pulses, and raises the voltage stress across the devices. Reduced switch count multi-level inverter is the solution to minimize these issues. Hence in this paper, performance analysis of multi-level inverters with reduced semiconductor switch counts for five-level and seven-level output is discussed. While the conventional five-level and seven-level inverter models respectively require eight and twelve switches, the reduced switch count five-level and seven-level inverters uses 6 and 5 switches. The performance of both conventional and inverters with fewer switches are analyzed through simulation by using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: RouteRover: AI-Enabled Traffic Congestion Prediction and Route Optimization for Indian Urbanites
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Here in this paper, a model that has been proposed for predicting and visually representing congestion of traffic using machine learning as well as deep learning. This initiative with the purpose of examining traffic data to obtain insights for traffic regulation and planning. The process initiates with an initial exploration of data through an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and to perceive the distribution and patterns within the dataset. Descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and visual aids are employed for this purpose. Following the EDA phase, tactics for manifold learning are utilized to simplify the dataset while retaining crucial information. Identifying significant features influencing the prediction of traffic volume is facilitated by methods for feature importance and selection. The obtained features are rigorously evaluated to comprehend traffic patterns and traffic jam levels. Visual representations capture the distribution of traffic volume based on factors like time, day, and month, assisting in pinpointing congestion hotspots and optimizing traffic flow. This project underscores the powerful impact of data analysis and feature extraction in offering practical insights for traffic regulation strategies.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach to Predict Kidney Disease Risk Factor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease(CKD), is a type of kidney failure or renal failure that extends over months or years, and Early diagnosis is vital to fight the disease and ensure proper treatment. This work develops a web application with user interface to prompt out whether a patient is prone to CDK or not. To necessitate this, the prominent features are selected using feature selection techniques and classification is performed by widely used classifiers. Each feature is computed by a score statistically utilizing feature Selection methods namely, Chi square, Correlation, Mutual Information, Fisher score and Mean Absolute Difference. Optimality test is performed to identify the optimal number of minimum features required and was found to be 5. Further, maximum voting technique is applied to identify the top 5 features among the results of all techniques. Accordingly, a ranking table is generated from which the top 5 features are identified as $\{$ Red blood cell count, Albumin, Packed Cell Volume, Hypertension, Specific gravity}. Different Classification Algorithms are used to predict the class labels. The performance results indicate best random forest, decision tree and logistic regression are the top 3 classifiers with accuracies of $\mathbf{9 7. 5 6 \%}, \quad \mathbf{9 5. 6 2 \%}, \mathbf{9 6. 2 5 \%}$ respectively; and thus, these classifiers were utilized for ensembling and have exhibited an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 7. 5 \%}$.

articleTitle: A Fusion of CNN, MLP, and MediaPipe for Advanced Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Hand gesture recognition has become evident as a critical component in human-centered computing systems. It provides users a natural intuitive way for users to interact with technology. The system introduced a concept of Gesture Fusion, a novel approach that leverages the complementary strengths of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), and the MediaPipe framework to achieve robust hand gesture recognition. By integrating these advanced techniques, fusion of models surpasses the limitations of individual model, delivering improved accuracy and robustness in recognizing a diverse range of hand gestures. The proposed system begins by preprocessing input images using CNNs to extract informative spatial features. Simultaneously, it utilizes the MediaPipe framework to accurately detect and localize key hand landmarks. These landmarks are then processed by MLPs to capture intricate patterns and variations in hand gestures that may not be fully captured by CNNs alone. By combining the outputs of both CNN and MLP models through a weighted fusion mechanism, synthesizes a comprehensive understanding of hand gestures, resulting in more precise and reliable recognition outcomes. Through significant research and evaluation on benchmark datasets, Fusion model outperforms independent CNN and MLP models. The findings obtained demonstrates the improved accuracy, resilience, and adaptability in a variety of real-world circumstances, confirming its potential to revolutionize the field of hand gesture detection. It advances the pursuit for more natural and intuitive human-computer interaction paradigms by seamlessly combining cutting-edge technologies and approaches.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Feature Selection Algorithms for Text Analytics: A Performance and Efficiency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In text analytics, high-dimensional datasets frequently impede model performance, rendering feature selection an essential process for enhancing accuracy and computing efficiency. This study examines and contrasts various feature selection algorithms, classified into filter, wrapper, and embedded techniques, within the realm of text analytics. The study evaluates the effectiveness of approaches including ChiSquared, Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE), and L1 Regularization on benchmark text datasets to ascertain their competence in dimensionality reduction while maintaining model performance. The findings illustrate the trade-offs between computational cost and performance, offering insights into the optimal use of feature selection techniques for various text classification tasks.

articleTitle: VLSI Implementation of Power Efficient 4-bit Flash ADC
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The project aims to design and implement a 4-bit Thermometer-coded Flash Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) using Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) technology. The proposed design employs a high-speed, fully parallel architecture that uses a resistor ladder network to generate the reference voltages for flash comparison. The ADC will be implemented using the 180 nm CMOS technology node, and simulation results will be obtained using Cadence Virtuoso tools. The performance of the design will be evaluated based on several metrics, including resolution, speed, power consumption, and accuracy. The project aims to achieve a high-resolution, high=speed ADC with low power consumption that is suitable for use in various applications, such as digital signal processing, data acquisition, and instrumentation. The results of this project can contribute to the development of advanced ADC designs and enhance the performance of various electronic systems.

articleTitle: Low Cost IOT Based Smart Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Modern surveillance systems with motion detection are widely available. This paper presents a costeffective prototype for a smart monitoring system designed using Espressif’s ESP32 microcontroller. The system incorporates motion-triggered image capture technology alongside a Passive Infrared (PIR) sensor.The monitoring system utilizes a PIR sensor and vibration sensor to detect motion and activate an ESP32 CAM module, which captures images of detected subjects. These images are then securely transmitted to a designated Telegram account over a continuous Wi-Fi connection. Additionally, a DHT11 sensor is integrated to measure environmental parameters like temperature and humidity, with the collected data uploaded to the ThingSpeak platform for remote monitoring and analysis. A connected bulb can also be controlled on demand, reducing power consumption and increasing energy efficiency. This intelligent system not only provides enhanced security but also contributes to sustainable energy management.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of an Eco-Friendly Remote controlled Fish Catching Bot for Coastal Fishing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This research presents the design and fabrication of an eco-friendly, remote-controlled fish-catching bot for coastal fishing, aimed at minimizing ecological impacts while ensuring efficient operation. Conventional fishing techniques often harm non-target aquatic species and involve non-selective fishing practices. In contrast, the fish-catching bot developed in this study aims to minimize these issues by selectively capturing fish without causing physical harm, allowing them to be kept alive for extended periods. This feature makes the device suitable for research, recreational fishing, and bulk capture while ensuring the well-being of the fish. Additionally, the bot is designed to reduce the human risks associated with fishing in unpredictable and harsh weather conditions. A key challenge in the design process was mitigating the sensitivity of fish to external vibrations. To address this, the bot was engineered to operate with minimal noise and vibration, with motors selectively driven to reduce disturbance. The fish-catching bot has been successfully designed, fabricated, and tested in aquatic environments demonstrating its viability for sustainable fishing.

articleTitle: Optimization of Data Aggregation Techniques in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Data aggregation is an essential factor in the Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) since it determines energy consumption and the precision of the data as well as the lifespan of the network. This work describes a new data aggregation algorithm that solves these problems since it reduces unnecessary broadcasts and groups information while still retaining critical details. The EM algorithm has been evaluated through extensive simulation and its application in real-world scenarios proved that it offers a 35% reduction in energy consumption, data accuracy, and network life cycle that is 30% longer than the existing approaches. The ability to work with different types of networks including the dynamic topologies and high data rate also exhibit the benefits of the algorithm. These results can help build better and more effective WSNs in the future as applicable in environment, health and industry sectors. This research presents a viable solution to the issue of data aggregation in WSN thus opening up the possibility of apply in different fields.

articleTitle: Enforcement of CNN Model in Drone Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Drones play a crucial role across various applications. However, their widespread use has raised concerns about potential misuse, includi surveillance, solicitation, and terrorism. Consequently, there is a growing demand for effective drone detection systems. A promising solution for this is the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Rhynchus is a system designed specifically for image recognition tasks. CNNs have proven highly effective in detecting drones in images, even under challenging conditions such as thick fog. In this paper, the objective is to develop a drone detection system with various applications. The proposed system consists of two main components: a feature extraction module and a classification module. The feature extraction module identifies relevant characteristics, such as shape, texture, and movement, from input images. The classification module uses these features to classify an object as either a drone or a non-drone. We will utilize a large dataset of drone images for training and evaluating the system, which includes a diverse array of drones and environments, ensuring robustness across different scenarios. Once developed, the system will be implemented on a real-time platform to showcase its effectiveness in real-world settings. It will be capable of detecting drones in real time using video feeds from cameras. The proposed drone detection system offers several advantages: it is accurate and resilient under various conditions, cost-effective to implement, and scalable for use in a wide range of scenarios.

articleTitle: Advancing Event Recognition in Videos Using Hybrid Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Event recognition in videos plays a critical role in various applications such as surveillance, security, and human-computer interaction. Conventional methods like Hidden Markov Models (HMM) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) have been extensively used, but they often struggle with handling complex data patterns and large-scale video datasets, leading to limited accuracy and inefficiency in real-time scenarios. These approaches fail to capture intricate temporal dependencies and suffer from high computational costs, making them less effective for dynamic event detection. To address these limitations, we propose a Hybrid Deep Learning Event Recognition Model (HDL-ERM), which combines the strengths of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. CNN is used for feature extraction, while LSTM effectively captures temporal sequences in video data. The HDL-ERM model significantly improves event recognition accuracy by 0.25%, while reducing computational load by 0.18% compared to conventional methods. By leveraging deep learning techniques, our proposed model enhances performance across various parameters such as processing speed, detection accuracy, and adaptability to different video environments.

articleTitle: Continuous Gesture Recognition in Human-Computer Interaction through Real-Time Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This paper focuses on the realisation of gesture recognition for permanent interaction with the human-computer interface using deep learning. The study focuses on the fact that the necessary gestures are dynamic and continuous, and the approach is based on the architecture that is CNN-LSTM hybrid for spatial features and temporal sequence modeling. The training and evaluation of the system are conducted on gesture datasets which are open source while real-time implementation is done on the edge devices by using the TensorRT. This proves its efficiency and promptness and the performance indicators are provided with regard to various scenarios. Research on the users showed positive responses concerning the unit and the degree of engagement the users had with the system. Nevertheless, the issues of generalization and increasing the computational speed are the main concerns for further development However, the presented work offers promising perspectives for the improvement of the gesture-based interfaces in the applications from virtual reality to assistive technology. In future research, we will improve the architecture proposed in the paper, add new features, make the system open to more kinds of data modalities, and enable it to learn more gestures and contexts for interactions in general.

articleTitle: Iris Recognition System Using Circular Hough Transform and HOG
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Iris recognition, a reliable biometric authentication method, uses the unique patterns of the human iris. This research introduces an effective approach for iris segmentation using the Circular Hough Transform (CHT). High-quality eye images are captured under near-infrared light, followed by preprocessing to enhance quality. CHT accurately determines the circular boundaries of the iris and pupil, and the extracted region is normalised to ensure consistent feature extraction. The Histogram of Orientated Gradients (HOG) is used to extract distinctive features, resulting in an iris code. Matching algorithms compare these codes against a database, evaluated through metrics such as accuracy. Results show that CHT significantly improves segmentation accuracy, reducing false acceptance and rejection rates. This experiment was carried out using greyscale eye image data obtained from an iris database at the Chinese Academy of Sciences Institute of Automation. The findings reveal that the proposed approach achieves 97.62% segmentation and normalisation accuracy, indicating that it is useful for iris recognition applications.

articleTitle: Leveraging CNN and CNN-LSTM Networks for Automated Diabetes Detection Using Heart Rate Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Simple biological signals are unpredictable and hard to plan for. The function of different bodily systems may be revealed via biomedical signals. This makes it difficult to observe these signals and extract temporal data. Use of signal processing methods has allowed for the extraction of valuable information from these signals. A large variety of illnesses may be found and named. Innovative technology that is safe and useful Doctors may find it helpful in identifying patients and therapy due to its exceptional accuracy in spotting abnormalities. control several illnesses. Until recently, machine learning was the only method available for bioanalysis of process data. Methods that rely on machine learning are now in use. Here, we use a deep learning network grouping of CNNs and LSTMs to automate diabetes diagnosis. An analysis of variability in heart rate (HRV) may be used to find diabetes. Up until now, no one has attempted to differentiate between normal HRV and diabetes using deep learning approaches. Its basis as LSTM is a modified continuous neural network (RNN). LSTM customs recollection chunks to address the issue of the disappearing and growing gradient. Once equated to RNNs, LSTMs performs much better when dealing with persistent dependencies. In other words, long short-term memories (LSTMs) may be able to connect seemingly distant events with the here and now. The current record for automated diabetes diagnosis employing HRV is 95.1%, accomplished by means of a CNN-LSTM 3 system with five-fold cross-validation. Regular classifiers and active feature extraction are unnecessary.

articleTitle: A System to Track Fabricated Content in Social media using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In today’s society, when the internet is pervasive, everyone gets their news from a variety of online sources. Information can swiftly reach millions of users in a short amount of time due to the growing usage of social media sites like Facebook, Twitter, and others. Fake news has far-reaching effects, ranging from swaying election outcomes in favor of particular politicians to fostering prejudiced viewpoints. The primary platforms for disseminating fake news are Instagram, WhatsApp, and numerous other social media platforms. By presenting a machine learning-based fake news detection algorithm, this work provides a remedy. This model needs fictitious data that was gathered from multiple information sources. Data is extracted using web analytics, which is mostly used to build datasets. Real data sets and fake data sets are the two primary categories into which the data is separated. Random forest, logistic regression, decision trees, KNN, and gradient boosting are the classifiers used to classify the data. The data is categorized as true or false data based on the version that was received. The user will be able to determine whether or not the information on the website is fraudulent based on this.

articleTitle: Metro Route Optimization for Urban Public Transportation Using Q-Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Nowadays, efficient public transport is crucial, particularly in those where pollution and traffic congestion are significant issues. This study introduces a great approach to using the learning algorithm like Q-learning for finding the best route for passengers. Metro networks, which link many towns and areas, are essential to the survival of many cities. We present an approach that treats the whole metro map as a graph with edges connecting nodes. We enable the system to learn the most efficient path for passengers based on the rewards and punishments associated with different behaviors through the use of a Q-learning algorithm, which is also a reinforcement learning algorithm. As we know, this learning is stateless, rule-free, and feedback-based, as opposed to traditional routing techniques; it can learn the best rules for urban routing. The goal is to shorten the overall time taken to travel by using fewer stops. Through simulations and use of real-time data, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for determining the best subway routes, helping to deliver better public transportation and availability for commuters in urban environments.

articleTitle: Automated Epilepsy Detection System Based On Tertiary Wavelet Model(TWM) Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: A computerized method for classifying epilepsy from electroencephalogram (EEG) data using a Tertiary Wavelet Model (TWM) as a feature extractor is detailed. Before extracting features such as PFD, HFD, and Approximate Entropy, the feature set is standardized. Then, the initial information is divided into five sub bands—gamma, beta, alpha, theta, and delta—in the suggested method for EEG information. We then use the Kruskal-Walli’s test to identify the traits that vary substantially across the various groups. Afterwards, the notable characteristics are fed into well-known machine learning algorithms as XGBoost, DT, KNN, SVM, and RF. The outcomes show that the Random Forest classifier (with a standard Sen of $\mathbf{9 9. 7 5 7 5 \%}$, Spe of $\mathbf{9 9. 9 1 \%}$, and Acc of $\mathbf{9 9. 1} \%$ in melanoma detection) is the best classification. By classifying the signals into seizure and non-seizure categories, the Bonn University EEG Databases are utilized provides the basis for the system’s overall evaluation. According to the results shown in the picture below, the suggested model outperforms the prior approaches. In epilepsy, this demonstrates that TWM improves both the calculation speed and accuracy of the discriminant in seizure detection.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on Power and Junction Temperature in 2, 4, 8 bit Multiplier Using Nikhlam Sutra
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Now a days several countries are struggling with energy shortage. In response to this issue, research and development efforts have focused on simulation and implementation of most power consuming device i.e. multiplier by means of ancient energy-efficient technology using Nikhlam technique of Ancient Indian Mathematics i.e. this innovation aims to support environmentally conscious communication technologies by enhancing energy efficiency. The Traditional method of multiplication takes a lot of time and steps, making it less efficient. Vedic procedure involves minimum number of steps as well as space-consuming. One of the multiplication methods is Nikhlam multiplication in which problems can be solved in a step or two. Among the families of FPGA, The Kintex 7, Defence Grade Artix 7, Spartan6, Spartan3E and Spartan-3A DSP have been evaluated for their energy consumption and temperature performance for two, four & Eight-bit multipliers.

articleTitle: Innovative Machine Learning Framework for Assessing Drug Response in Cancer Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The lifespan and cancer therapy have improved due to bioinformatics advances. Mutations and changes in a patient’s cell genes create cancer, which is tough to treat, particularly in the tumor microenvironment. More tailored treatments are needed since even people with the same cancer respond differently to similar medicines. Researchers seek faster alternatives to clinical trials for medication discovery. Big data on oncology and pharmacogenomics has boosted the sector. Machine learning and data mining play crucial roles in interpreting this knowledge and driving cancer therapy advancements. This work proposes a kernelized similarity-based periodicity matrix decomposition methodology for predicting cancer-fighting treatment response, assuming comparable pharmacological responses. Critical characteristics for the goal function are drug-drug chemical similarities in structure and tissue gene expression. Maps non-linear drugtissue connections using the kernel function. We present an integrated methodology for finding synergistic cancer prevention medication combinations. Features from individual drug response data are used to predict drug interaction in our integrated strategy. On those extracted characteristics, proposed KSRMF model outperformed compared to all other machine learning models by having accuracy of 9 2. 4 5% and highest performance. We evaluated our approach on mutantBRAF carcinoma and AstraZeneca-Sanger Drug Combining Information Prediction DREAM Challenge cell lines. This system for medication synergy prediction is strong and effectiveness, promising individualized cancer therapy.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Multiplication: Implementing Vedic Sutra Principles in Multiplier Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Ancient Indian Mathematics, known as Vedic Mathematics, draws from 16 principles found in ancient Indian scriptures (Vedas). Among these principles, Urdhva Tiryakbhyam, Ekanyunena Purvena, and Ekadhikena Purvena stand out for their relevance in modern computation. In recent decades, there has been significant interest in developing fast multiplier circuits, with Vedic multipliers gaining favor due to their efficiency in terms of speed, space utilization, and power consumption. This study examines the performance of these sutras, particularly in the context of $\mathbf{1 6}$-bit operations, using Verilog programming language for implementation and Vivado 2017.1 for synthesis and testing. Through simulations and analysis, the aim is to identify optimal outcomes in terms of area, speed, and power efficiency, contributing to advancements in digital signal systems and processor design.

articleTitle: Performance of XG Boost over other ML models for Prediction of CVD
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Cardiovascular Disease (CVD), the world’s largest cause of sickness, affects millions of individuals annually, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. Early detection of CVD is crucial since conventional diagnostic methods usually lead to incorrect diagnoses and postponed treatment, increasing healthcare expenses and adversely influencing patient outcomes. This study explores the transformative potential of artificial intelligence, specifically machine learning algorithms, to increase the accuracy and efficacy of CVD diagnosis. To improve early CVD diagnosis, this study recommends utilizing a few machine learning methods. More than 32,000 records with attributes like age, sex, BMI, stroke, mental health, etc. are included in this sizable Kaggle dataset. Compared to all other algorithms, XGBoost performed competitively, with $\mathbf{9 4 . 1 \%}$ accuracy and $88.6 \%$ precision. The comparison illustrates the benefits of this strategy and the significance of these advancements in promoting early diagnosis and customized treatment regimens. Finally, by improving prediction skills, the results show how machine learning may transform the diagnosis of CVD and enhance healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: Optimized Audio Classification with Convolutional Neural Network Ensembles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In this work, we present a structured approach to a typical audio classification task, focusing specifically on Music Genre Classification (MGC). We develop and test three different Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures, each containing various layer configurations, including Conv2d, Dropout, and Batch Normalization layers. These variations allow us to analyze the impact of each layer type on the overall model performance, providing insights into their individual contributions to effective genre classification. After that, we apply PROD fusion ensemble technique to combine multiple predicted probability vectors at inference phase to further improve the model performance. By conducting experiments on the best model performing an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 0 . 8 \%}$, which is a good accuracy and potential for real-life applications.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Stem Bleeding in Coconut Trees using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In Coconut trees a deadly illness called stem bleeding caused by bacteria called by Thielaviopsis paradoxa results in large financial losses for the industry. To lessen the effects of this illness, early detection and prompt care are essential. Conventional detection techniques mostly rely on labor-intensive, frequently erroneous manual inspection. The novel method for detecting stem bleeding in coconut trees that makes use of image processing techniques is presented in this paper. This method involves capturing high-resolution images of the coconut tree stems and applying sophisticated image processing algorithms to identify early symptoms of the disease. Features such as color changes, variations in texture, and patterns of lesions are extracted from the images and analyzed using machine learning models. These models are then used to accurately differentiate between healthy trees and those affected by stem bleeding. The proposed system evaluates on an extensive dataset of images collected from various coconut plantations, and the results show a high level of accuracy and efficiency in detecting the disease. The findings suggest that this image processing-based approach can significantly enhance the early detection process, allowing farmers to take swift and effective action. Moreover, the technology offers the potential to reduce the reliance on manual labor, thus cutting down labor costs while improving the precision of disease detection. In the long run, this system could play a pivotal role in boosting the sustainability and profitability of coconut farming.

articleTitle: Designing an Energy-Efficient Wireless Sensor Network Model for Effective Intruder Detection and Minimizing Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: A new and exciting field of study known as WSNs has recently grown in prominence. The individual nodes that make up these networks are tiny, battery-operated gadgets that include sensors, CPUs, and mobile connectivity modules. When placed properly over a region, WSNs can detect and record changes in variables like moistness, illumination, tension, and vibration, among others. Wireless transmissions carry the gathered data to a centralized gateway or base station (BS), which then transmits it to a data center for more processing and analysis. In order for WSNs to be deployed and operated effectively, a number of obstacles must be overcome. The radius of coverage and the network’s capacity to gather data from faraway nodes are both impacted by communication range limits. Intruder detection requiring extra monitoring nodes is made possible by a network of wireless sensors protocol that is proposed in this section. The protocol identifies valid nodes and detects any intrusions by using acknowledgments rather than depending on specialized monitoring nodes. By using this route, we can guarantee efficient intrusion detection inside the network without wasting any additional resources. Hence, building a network with varying node density also boosts network lifetime and decreases energy use. Using different node densities improves intrusion detection, according to the simulation findings. In order to ensure the privacy and security of sensitive information, $\mathbf{C H}$ is crucial for identifying potential threats. When compared to SEP, LEACH, and TSEP, the proposed EERP model achieves $\mathbf{9 7 \%}$ in packet delivery rate and also better results in areas covered, energy efficiency, and intrusion detection.

articleTitle: An Hand Gesture Smart Translation System for Differently Abled People
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Among the nonverbal forms of communication techniques utilized in sign language is hand signals. People who are deaf or hard of hearing or speech frequently utilize it. They struggle to communicate with others or with each other. Numerous manufacturers worldwide have produced a variety of sign language systems, however they are inefficient and incompatible with one another in terms of cost. Our works objective is to develop a deaf communication system. There are two sections to this project. (1)Sign language conversion from the audio messages (2) Converting pictures and videos into speech or text. In the first section we will examine, audio is taken as input, the recorded spoken message is converted into text, and Hindi Sign language graphics or GIFs are displayed. The hearing and the deaf can communicate more easily when this method is used. In the second group, we gather the photographs, use CNN to train them, and display the outcomes.

articleTitle: Smart Iridology: Deep Learning for Predictive Health Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This study aims to develop a reliable, non-invasive method for predicting early health issues through iridology by leveraging computer vision and deep learning techniques. Iridology, which involves the analysis of iris patterns, is explored for its potential to provide early indications of health conditions. The methodology involved capturing high-quality iris images using a specialized camera, followed by processing and analysis using advanced computer vision techniques. A deep learning model was implemented to detect early stages of conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and heart diseases. The model achieved an average accuracy of 93.7%, demonstrating superior performance in precision, sensitivity, and specificity compared to other leading machine learning approaches. These findings suggest that the proposed method could serve as a robust tool for early health issue detection, with implications for enhancing public health outcomes and reducing healthcare costs.

articleTitle: Tomato Leaf Disease Detection Using ML, IP and Fabrication of Pesticides Spraying Prototype
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This report explores cutting-edge methods for improving tomato cultivation through efficient disease detection and precise pesticide application. Employing Machine Learning (ML) and Image Processing (IP) techniques, we enhance the speed and accuracy of disease identification on tomato leaves. Furthermore, a novel pesticide spraying prototype isintroduced, designed to target only diseased areas, reducing pesticide usage and environmental impact. By integrating thesetechnologies, we aim to revolutionize tomato farming practices, enabling early disease intervention, minimizing crop damage, and promoting sustainable agriculture. The report underscoresthe significance of adopting advanced techniques to address agricultural challenges, ensuring the health and productivity oftomato crops while minimizing environmental harm.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Vedic Multiplier using Kogge Stone Adder and Reversible Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: As DSP applications continue to advance, the demand for faster and more power-efficient multipliers persists. Reversible logic emerges as a promising solution to mitigate power dissipation, theoretically offering zero power consumption. Leveraging the efficiency of Vedic mathematics techniques, particularly the Urdhva Tiryakbhayam algorithm, becomes imperative in addressing speed and power concerns in multiplier implementation. This study focuses on implementing an $8 \times 8$ Vedic multiplier utilizing the Kogge Stone Adder and optimizing for power using reversible logic. The design is simulated and synthesized in Cadence tool 180 nm technology. Performance evaluation of the Vedic multiplier is conducted, assessing its area, speed, and power consumption. The performance of Vedic multiplier implemented with conventional gates is compared with the implementation using reversible gates. The comparison shows considerable improvement in power for multiplier with reversible logic. The synthesis results shows that power reduction by $7.2 \%$ over conventional gate implementation. At the same time, the implementation suffers from area and datapath delay overhead by $16.87 \%$ and $27 \%$ respectively.

articleTitle: Optimized Parallel and Serial Array Antenna Design for X-Band Aviation Radar Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This paper aims to devise an antenna structure tailored for seamless integration into aviation radar sensors. The primary design objectives entail the creation of an antenna resonating within the X-band frequency range, spanning from 8 GHz to 12 GHz, with a central frequency of 9.79 GHz, while prioritizing portability. A meticulously dimensioned unit cell is engineered to achieve these specifications, resulting in an antenna design operating at 10.36 GHz. Key parameters including S11, Gain, Efficiency, and Radiation characteristics are meticulously assessed. Subsequently, these unit cells are arranged in serial and parallel configurations and analyzed across various metrics. Noteworthy findings reveal that the parallel array design exhibits superior radiation performance at 10.3 GHz. In contrast, the serial array configuration demonstrates enhanced attributes, including higher gain and improved S-parameter characteristics, particularly at 10.8 GHz. The input impedances were readily adjusted to match 50-ohm feedlines. The antenna design leverages dielectric materials such as Duriod for the substrate and copper for the patch and ground components. Specifically, the Duriod substrate boasts a dielectric coefficient of 2.2, with a substrate thickness of 1.57 and a copper thickness of ${0. 0 3 5}$. This investigation underscores the efficacy of the serial array antenna design, highlighting its potential for optimal performance in aviation radar sensor applications..

articleTitle: Tooth Enamel segmentation from dental x-ray using MASK R-CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In order to detect cavities on teeth, dentists analyse dental x-rays. Initially, dental cavities develop on the delicate surface of the teeth, known as enamel, and subsequently progress to the pulp and the root of the teeth. The reconstruction of three-dimensional dentition models for use in a variety of clinical applications is contingent upon the precise segmentation of teeth. Nevertheless, performing manual segmentation is time-consuming and susceptible to intra- and inter-observer variability. Convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithms can automatically segment teeth; however, the majority of CNN algorithms necessitate manual marking on a vast training database and extreme computational capacity. Theoretical Orientation and Methodology: This investigation assesses the feasibility of employing a transfer-learning algorithm, “Mask R-CNN,” which necessitates a modest training database and minimal computational resources. This work is designed to accomplish our objective of segmenting the enamel region of the teeth from dental x -rays using an algorithm such as Mask renn. The extraction of the enamel region is essential in the process of cavity detection using deep learning, as the cavity initially develops on the enamel region. The “Mask R-CNN” method is implemented with a standard computational capacity and a minimal training database to accomplish high-quality dental recognition within a reasonable train duration. This has the potential to promote more precise treatment planning and diagnosis by eliminating subjective errors.

articleTitle: Unlocking a New Era in Human-Computer Interaction with Transformative AI Virtual Mice for Unparalleled Accessibility, Hygiene, and User Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The ubiquitous physical mouse, despite its years of service, presents challenges in accessibility, hygiene, and user experience. This paper explores the transformative potential of AI Virtual Mouse (AI VM) systems, powered by deep learning, to revolutionize human-computer interaction (HCI). We are involved in the intricate interplay between computer vision and deep learning architectures, dissecting various approaches to hand segmentation, gesture recognition, and model training. Through rigorous evaluation based on accuracy, speed, and robustness, we analyze the strengths and weaknesses of different configurations, paving the way for optimal performance. This example of the advancement of touchless HCI interfaces also opens doors to exciting future directions, including personalized control, integration with AR/VR technologies, and broader applications across diverse domains. For decades, the humble physical mouse has reigned supreme as our gateway to the digital world. Yet, despite its familiarity, it comes with limitations – accessibility hurdles, hygiene concerns, and a user experience that has not fundamentally evolved. This paper heralds a transformative era, where AI Virtual Mouse (AI VM) systems, powered by the magic of deep learning, are poised to revolutionize human-computer interaction (HCI).

articleTitle: Hand Gestures Mechanism for Controlling and Supervising the Smart Mattress
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Automation plays a crucial role in our everyday lives, and hand gesture recognition is a key component in this field. In this journal addresses the challenge of adjusting bed positions using hand gestures by the method of Media Pipes. For effective real-time implementation, hand gesture recognition needs to be integrated with mutual applications. PC are used to facilitate hand gestures for human-computer interaction in real-time. In This paper demonstrates a system that adjusts the bed’s position through hand gestures using Programmable camera like processing laptop. With the growing number of disabled patients and the lack of caretakers due to social and financial constraints, this system aims to reduce the need for constant monitoring and increase patient comfort.The central component of the system is an Arduino board which coordinates the inputs and outputs from various sensors and devices. The bed’s position is controlled by various hand gestures, and the system also includes a patient monitoring feature that tracks parameters like temperature and pulse rate. If any of these parameters fall below safe levels, the system sends an alert to the doctor via SMS. The system also contains a continuous patient monitoring system that monitors various parameters such as temperature,pulse rate,hand gesture and bed position.

articleTitle: Retinal Blood Vessel Segmentation using The U-NetModel with the XAI Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Segmenting retinal blood vessels is important because the retinal microvasculature is a vital biomarker for severalclinical disorders. On the other hand, the conventional approach is thought to be a laborious and time-consuming process. The potential of deep learning and artificial intelligence in particular has created new opportunities for effectively segmenting retinal arteries. In our research, we provide a strategy to extract retinal blood vessels from fundus visuals using the U-Net model, whichis commonly used in semantic segmentation. A dataset for the study is obtained from the Kaggle resource. We performed pre-processing before feeding the images into the models based onthe need for deep-learning models. Moreover, we applied a U-Netmodel to segment the stereophotogrammetric converted images. Concerning the quality of the approach, the Intersection of Union (IoU), accuracy, and F1-Score measurements were employed. Furthermore, to enhance the grain of the segmentation results and to build confidence in the method we discuss the incorporation of eXplainable AI known as Grad-CAM. Therefore, this work shows that deep learning can be highly effective for retinal vessel segmentation and at the same time underlines the need for interpretability issues in medical image analysis.

articleTitle: Leveraging Explainable AI and Optimized Deep Learning for Enhanced Leukemia Detection Using Otsu Threshold Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The identification of aberrant blood cell features is an essential part of the leukaemia diagnosis process, and at the moment, this is accomplished by manual inspection by pathologists who have received training. The morphological characteristics of white blood cells are examined in microscopic pictures as part of this process. The incorporation and implementation of a computerised system vision-based system presents a number of important problems, despite the fact that there are certain machines and chemical-based tests accessible. This stage is responsible for isolating the areas of interest in order to provide an accurate diagnosis. The current work investigates an efficient and composite segmented strategy to improve the effectiveness and efficacy of leukaemia diagnosis. This is done in order to solve the issue that has been raised. For the purpose of this inquiry, the dataset that has been employed is the acute lymphoblastic leukaemia-related image database, often known as ALL-IDB. The Otsu and Kapur approaches, which make use of multiple thresholding, take the pictures through a phase of pre-processing before they are segmented. The use of the concept of enthusiasm-based teaching-learning-based optimisation (LebTLBO) method results in an additional enhancement of the results of segmentation. The suggested LebTLBO approach outperforms the others by a wide margin, reaching an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8 \%}$. Kapur, MTOtsu, Otsu, and MTKapur are all less accurate than MTKapur. This demonstrates how the LebTLBO approach outperforms the others in terms of error minimisation and result reliability.

articleTitle: A Fog Cluster-based Interpretable AI Framework for Human Activity Recognition and Personalized Healthcare Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The innovations made possible by the Internet of Things have been of enormous use to the healthcare sector. These developments have made it feasible for a multitude of applications to collect huge amounts of information from users for evaluation in the cloud. On the other hand, immediate medical care need very low latency as well as which is something that traditional cloud computing is not able to supply. Fog computing is a solution that has emerged as a result of this issue. It allows for the processing of data that is nearer to its origin, which in turn reduces latency and the amount of bandwidth that is used. In the paper, a novel system is proposed that takes use of fog clusters. Fog clusters are groupings of fog nodes that collaborate with one another to accelerate and distribute the processing of tasks. According to the findings, fog clusters significantly cut down on latency and energy usage, which demonstrates the usefulness of fog technology in Internet of Things (IoT) systems that have stringent latency requirements. This study was carried out with the assistance of a simulation of an individual with a COPD monitoring system.

articleTitle: Optimizing Fish Classification with a Hybrid SAE-SVM Model: Performance and Evaluation on Fish-gres and Fish4-Knowledge Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Accurate classification of fishes is thus very important in marine biology for species identification, biodiversity monitoring, and ecological studies. Most typical methods used are manual feature extraction techniques and expert analyses, which generally are time-consuming and unreliable. These are, however, surmounted in effectiveness and scalability by automated classification systems, especially those based on picture data. In the context of the present research, we focus our attention on the development of an image-based fish classification system supported by deep learning technologies. It could potentially enhance both the accuracy and speed of species identification much further. We propose one of its kind classification systems that employs a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The feature extraction and analysis process are done automatically through cascadable convolutional layers from the first stage to the last. Convolution neural networks, owing to their multilayer composition, manage to extract high-level features, but this extraction normally occurs at the partialcost of some essential low-level information which may reside in further layers. The hybrid approach proposed here handles this limitation because CNN is combined with a Stacked Autoencoder for dimensionality reduction and hence Support Vector Machine for classification. This has aimed to reduce the impact of the mentioned constraint. It also helps the SVM to enhance the process of classification, while the autoencoder contributes to maintaining low-level information. The findings of our experiments reveal that our hybrid model performs better compared to state-of-the-art approaches, proving its usefulness in the classification of fish species.

articleTitle: DreamSpace VR: Redefining Home Tours in the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Virtual Reality Property Tour is a groundbreaking undertaking aimed toward revolutionizing the actual property enterprise by leveraging immersive technologies. This progressive endeavor specializes in developing a unbroken, interactive, and realistic digital environment that allows potential consumers to discover houses remotely. Integrating present day VR hardware and software, this project objectives to go beyond geographical obstacles, supplying customers an unprecedented revel in in traveling properties from anywhere in the world. The development system includes meticulous making plans, incorporating usercentric layout concepts for intuitive navigation and interaction in the digital area. Through superior three-D modeling and rendering strategies, life like representations of homes is crafted, permitting users to visualize spaces with exceptional element and accuracy. Key functions include a person-pleasant interface facilitating easy exploration, specified assets showcases highlighting services, dimensions, and architectural nuances. The task’s importance lies in its capacity to redefine belongings showcasing, improving the consumer experience, and streamlining choice-making processes for searching for what you offer. Initial trying out and feedback underscore the undertaking’s success in engaging customers and fostering a feel of realism. As the real property panorama evolves, this Virtual Reality Property Tour challenge stands at the leading edge, poised to revolutionize property viewing experiences and remodel the manner homes are advertised and sold.

articleTitle: Improving Adversarial Attacks On Graph Neural Networks With Honey Badger Optimization And Efficient Parallel Defense Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: It is becoming very useful to learn from graphstructured data using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs); however, these networks are vulnerable to adversarial attacks. There are numerous other distinct ways in which these assaults can be performed, such as evasion, poisoning or perturbation. When such a situation happens the performance of the GNN models drastically reduces with high possibility of wrong forecasts or classifications which may not be required. Regulus and TensorMap are quite insecure; GNNs are more secure in areas of high risk such as healthcare, cybersecurity and financial institutions, thus, it is mandatory to secure GNNs. The goal of this work is to present a wide range of possible adversarial perturbations to provide a broader evaluation of the vulnerabilities of GNNs. In order to make larger-scale GNNs more immune to adversarial effects, the authors present a parallel defensive framework that includes adversarial training, graph sanitization, and resilient aggregation strategies. By incorporating this framework, the model resistance brought about by different adversarial approaches is significantly enhanced, and this is achieved alongside a preservation of adequate performance on classic tasks.

articleTitle: Campus Navigator: Your Go-To Chatbot For Academic Advice And Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The creation of an intelligent chatbot for the Educational Institute’s website is the subject of this study. Driven by conversational AI, the chatbot aims to enhance student engagement by providing accurate and timely responses. Objectives include admission guidance, course information, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement through user feedback. The systematic methodology covers project planning, data collection, chatbot development, personalization, security, and deployment. Positioned as a strategic move in response to modern challenges, the chatbot represents a $24 / 7$ accessible virtual assistant, aligning with the broader trend of digital transformation in higher education. The article provides a comprehensive approach to creating an intelligent and user-friendly chatbot that seamlessly aligns with our college’s digital presence.

articleTitle: Leveraging LSTM-based Auto-Encoders for Covid-19 Severity Prediction and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The primary purpose of this study activity is to give its share to the battle against the growing threats posed by COVID-19 all over the world, which has over one million cases. According to the World Health Organisation (WHO), more than seven million individuals have been reported to have passed away as a result of; the work is focused on building an optimization-based deep learning model that will assist in identifying COVID-19 patients based on early clinical information. The suggested model is pretty accurate for the prediction of COVID-19 and improves the strictness of the forecasts of the ailment. This is accomplished by combining the medical and personal data from a variety of populations. In the preliminary stage, the only things that can be determined are the pre-processing phase and the characteristics that are pertinent for classification using ESDO. The efficacy is characterised by the use of a classifier that combines LSTM and AE. This allows for the determination of the degree of severity, which may range from mild to moderate to severe, with a precision of $\mathbf{9 9 \%} \mathbf{. 0. 0 2}$, and a level of accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8}$. Therefore, future study will concentrate on applying the offered approach for the affected regions in India exclusively, and efforts will also be made to compare the suggested methodology to larger databases, if any such databases exist.

articleTitle: Advanced Machine Learning Algorithms for 1Predictive Analytics in Healthcare to Enhance Patient Outcomes with Data-Driven Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This research aims to explore the use of modern complex defensive machine learning algorithms in the provision of predictive analytics for health improvement. Incorporating electronic health records, medical image information, and genomic data the work proposes and assesses multiple machine learning models including deep learning, ensemble learning, and reinforcement learning. The main findings shown very high performance in disease prediction, in chronic illness and in the application of efficiency improvements in hospitals as a whole. Overall, such threats as data quality, data privacy, and model interpretability have been discussed in the research and emphasize the importance of the machine learning approach in healthcare. It is highlighted that further development and integration of the interdisciplinary approaches as well as the use of the transparent and interpretable artificial intelligence and machine learning models can be urgent to increase the acceptance among the healthcare staff. This paper enhances the literature on applying machine learning in healthcare systems adding to the repertoire of knowledge for improved patient care.

articleTitle: Reflection compensation and binary thresholding using the Homomorphic Filtering approach for composite manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The global aerospace manufacturing industry is witnessing a major paradigm shift in design and material choice from metals to composites such as Carbon Fiber Reinforcement Plastics (CFRP) in civil and military aircraft structure design. In prepreg-based composite fabrication, multiple sheets of prepreg material are manually laid in the desired orientation on a mold. The layout process is subjected to 100 percent ply-by-ply manual visual inspection for detecting inclusion which can arise when the protective films are missed to get removed or due to the tackiness of the prepregs layers, other materials used in the process get included between layers. Manual inspection during layup is skill-based. The black and reflective nature of the surface makes it difficult to detect the inclusions efficiently. Thus, there exists a need for an automated or semi-automated system that can aid the inspector in detecting and identifying inclusions during fabrication. This paper inculcates the preliminary work carried out towards developing a methodology to identify the inclusions using image processing algorithms. One of the challenges to using the images is the reflection from the layers. A homomorphic filtering-based approach was developed to reduce the effects of reflection and binary thresholding to detect the inclusion regions. The developed methodology was validated through experimental results. It is found that Homomorphic filtering-based reflection compensation and binary thresholding can distinguish the inclusion regions, which can be used by the inspector in the clean room environment.

articleTitle: Swarm Intelligence-Based Bio Inspired Algorithm for Patch Antenna Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: the design of pentagon shape oriented patch antenna then its simulation, parameter optimization later on its fabrication and at the end it’s testing is presented in this study. Optimization process reduces the antenna’s dimensions to $5 \mathbf{c m}$ by $5 \mathbf{c m}$. For antenna optimization, the ant colony optimization algorithm (ACO) was selected. An ant colony optimization algorithm (ACO) was used to vary the side length and feeding location of the pentagon-shaped antenna, which was fed by a coaxial wire with a 1.59 mm diameter. The optimization aimed to identify parameters which improve the antenna’s working efficiency. We have implemented the ACO Algorithm using MATLAB software.
