The antenna was designed using the Ansys HFSS program. MATLAB can integrate with Ansys HFSS software to facilitate optimization. The return loss and Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) were the metrics taken into consideration. The ACO produced a design that was 5 cm by 5 cm in size and had a S11 of -27.96 dB and a Voltage standing wave ratio which was 1.08 at operating frequency of 2.4 GHz. using a network analyser, the constructed antenna was tested in an anechoic environment. The measurements obtained from the modelling and the fabrication of the antenna showed high agreement for the VSWR parameters and good performance in return loss at the 2.4 GHz operating frequency

Author Keywords: S11 reflection coefficient or return loss

articleTitle: Advancements in Climate Modeling and Prediction through Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The popularity of Machine learning (ML) is increased in the field of weather and climate modelling. Enforcement variety from improved resolution and pre-condition to structure scheme propagation and substitute, and lately even to entire ML climate and climatology predictive models. Linear Structural Equation Models (LSES) have been used, employed and mastered, that for the timed which exceeded 25 years that towards this point have remained dormant. Rather more intensive progress of this domain of knowledge has been observed during the last decade. articleTitle: Enhancing Care and Communication for Paralyzed Patients: A Microcontroller-Based Gesture Sensor Approach with GSM Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In today’s society, numerous individuals are experiencing physical disabilities caused by paralysis or accidents, resulting in a dependence on caregivers. Paralysis is characterized by the impairment of one or more muscles in the body, and microcontroller-based circuitry plays a crucial role in assisting these patients. In some cases, appliances are controlled by the patient’s hand motion, while the system also monitors the patient’s needs, heartbeat and temperature. When a paralysis attack occurs, the patient’s body may be partially or fully immobilized, making communication challenging. This makes it difficult for medical staff to comprehend the patient’s needs, such as eating, drinking, bathing, and other daily activities. This paper enables health officers to assist paralyzed patients by responding to messages sent via the GSM network. The paper includes several gesture sensor instructions to help health officers meet the needs of paralyzed patients.

articleTitle: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things for Enhanced Shuttle Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In expansive workspaces and educational campuses, effective and dependable modes of transport are integral to smooth operations and mobility of people within campus. Shuttle buses serve as the only mode of commute for these sprawling school campuses linking different areas. Defects in shuttle operations such as long queues at the bus stop or uncertain arrival dates can be inconvenient and wasteful on users’ side. This project aims at making campus shuttles more efficient and user-friendly through real-time tracking, predictive arrival times, and operational analysis. By using the Global Positioning System (GPS) technology along with Internet of Things (IoT) devices, the system display the live shuttle locations as well as predict arrival times while also analyzing the shuttle speed with the aim of optimizing routes alongside fuel consumption. The objective is therefore reducing waiting time, improving commuting experience in general while contributing towards sustainability in transportation systems within campuses.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization of Silicon Nanowire MOSFETs for Next-Generation Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This paper presents performance optimization of Silicon-Nanowire-Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor-Field-EffectTransistors (Si-NW-MOSFETs). As the semiconductor industry progresses toward smaller and more efficient device dimensions, the advantages of silicon nanowire MOSFETs have become increasingly prominent. Si NW MOSFETs are positioned as key candidates for future integrated circuit technologies, owing to their exceptional attributes, including high on-current and minimal leakage current. This study establishes crucial parameters at a gate voltage of 1.5 V and a drain voltage of 1 V: Sub-threshold Swing ($\mathrm{SS}=\mathbf{6 6 ~ m V} /$ decade), Leakage Current ($l_{\text {off }}=1 \mathbf{p A} /\mu \mathrm{m}$), Threshold Voltage $V_{\text {th }}=0.346 \mathbf{V}$, On Current ($\left(I_{o n}=14 \mu \mathrm{~A} / \mu \mathrm{m}\right)$, On/Off Ratio ($\frac{10 n}{\text { Ioff }}=10^{7}$), and Trans-conductance ($\mathrm{g}_{m}=800 \mu \mathrm{~S} / \mu \mathrm{m}$). Results indicate marked enhancements in drive current and sub threshold slope when compared to traditional MOSFETs, underscoring the potential of nanowire configurations to address future scaling challenges.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Powered Decentralized Resource Allocation and Management for Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This research proposes a blockchain based Distributed Resource Management and Allocation (DRMA) system for the Cloud Computing environment to overcome the shortcomings, ill prepared security and high cost incurred by the CC based on centralized and monolithic cloud architecture. The proposed system takes advantage of blockchain systems since they are distributed and due to their capability of not being altered once implemented, smart contracts are used to facilitate the distribution of resources. Moreover, the application of the Proof-of-Stake consensus mechanism and dynamic algorithms to distribute resources and prevent resource monopolization allow obtaining a high level of resource utilization together with low fees and high security levels. The implementation utilizes Ethereum’s blockchain and evaluate real-world cloud environments’ efficiency for resource utilization, transaction throughput, cost and robustness. This paper examines how blockchain has the propensity to redesign the means through which cloud computing resource management while improving its security, efficiency, and scalability.

articleTitle: Optimizing Coverage and Connectivity with Energy-Efficient Protocols in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: WSNs are a relatively young but promising area of research. Tiny, battery-powered gadgets with sensors, central processing units, and mobile connection components make up the separate nodes that comprise such networks. By carefully positioning themselves across an area, WSNs are able to identify and document changes in a wide range of environmental factors, including but not limited to temperature, light, stress, and vibrations. The collected data is sent to a computer system for further analysis and processing via wireless communication to an administrative gateway or base stations (BS). We need to overcome a lot of barriers before we can install and run WSNs successfully. Some instances of these challenges are a short battery lifespan, a limited communication range, and the need to assure data security. An essential factor to consider is the endurance of the batteries of nodes that sense since they are often located in uncomfortable and remote areas where it would be impractical to regularly replace or recharge them. The coverage area and the capability of the network to receive data from considerably nodes are both affected by the limitations of communication range. This paper proposes an Energy-Efficient Routing Protocol (EERP) designed specifically for heterogeneity WSNs with the goal of optimizing networks reach, communication, and energy consumption. In several respects, we showed in our calculations that the EERP is superior than the Threshold Sensitive Stable Election Protocol (TSEP) with having 100% results. In order to boost the transfer of packets to the base station, the EERP minimizes the total amount of active nodes, thus maximizing the area covered. Because of this, the EERP prolongs the life of the network far more than TSEP.

articleTitle: Rhombic Shaped Photonic Crystal Biosensor for the Detection of Eye Melanoma
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation for the detection of the eye melanoma cancer cell. The proposed design is based on the rhombic shaped structure photonic crystal. For the detection of eye melanoma cancer cells in a sample, a biosensor designed and simulated. The designed rhombic shaped photonic crystal has a hexagonal lattice and holes and a sample to detect cancer and normal cells, For the measurement of the sensor’s performance. It is constructed with silicon in air using the Finite-Difference Time-Domain tool. For the rhombic structure quality factor (Q-factor), sensitivity and full width at half maximum (FWHM) are calculated. The maximum q-factor for the rhombic structure obtained is 1873 and the sensitivity is $655(\mathrm{~nm} /$ RIU), with a resonant wavelength range of 1592 to $1593(\mathrm{~nm})$.

articleTitle: Classifying EEG Signals for Seizure Detection with Non-Linear Vector Decomposed Neural Network (NVDN) Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: A seizure is a neurological phenomenon that results from episodic pathological neuronal discharge in the brain, and can be recorded on electroencephalogram (EEG). Seizure detection is a major determinant of seizure management and therefore timely seizures detection is important in managing the problem. This work suggests the use of new NonLinear Vector Decomposed Neural Network analysis methods in the context of the classification of EEG signal to detect seizures. By decomposing a relatively complex structure of signals that are recorded from the scalp through the use of the NVDN framework, the model is able to better decode the constellations of features that may be indicative of seizure activity. To that end, we used an extensive data of EEG signals which was preprocessed by cleaning up noise and artifacts before performing feature extraction based on time frequency analysis. NVDN model was trained and tested against traditional machine learning algorithms to show enhanced accuracy sensitivity and specificity. The results show that with the help of the proposed NVDN technique, one can remarkably enhance seizure detection, which opens up the possibility of creating real-time monitoring systems for clinical practice. The findings of this work advance current knowledge of intelligent seizure detection systems and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of PAPR Reduction Method using Windowing Technique and Digital Predistortion Technique for OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Digital transmission known as orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is primarily employed in wireless communication because of its capacity for data transfer and resistance to multipath fading. The OFDM signal’s primary constraint is its relatively high Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR). The peak window, with its flexible interoperability and easy to implement, is an effective measure of PAPR reduction technique. When employing SLM (Selective Mapping) to reduce PAPR, researchers have utilized a significant amount of side information (SI). When reducing PAPR utilizing a partial transmit sequence (PTS), the researcher considered an average PAPR decrease at the expense of thoroughly looking through every rotation phase combination. This paper proposes the use of Peak window functions for PAPR reduction. When a high-power amplifier (HPA) receives an OFDM signal with a high PAPR, it will cause highly nonlinear distortions that will raise the bit error rate (BER) of the entire system thereby reducing HPA power efficiency. In order to produce an OFDM signal with lower PAPR and improved BER, PAPR optimization with error vector magnitude (EVM) constraints has been investigated in this study. In order to counteract the effects of nonlinearities in a power amplifier (PA), the research suggests designing, training, and testing a neural network to apply digital predistortion (DPD). The neural network-based DPD (NN-DPD) offline training is the main topic of the paper.

articleTitle: A Mixed-Methods of ML Strategy for Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Using Classification Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Heart attack and stroke poses a threat to public health due to its high death rate and widespread occurrence. The era of early heart illness prediction based on a handful of straightforward physical indicators gleaned from standard physical examinations is passed. In order to establish precise forecasts and make genuine attempts towards future diagnosis, signs of cardiac sickness are very responsive and clinically important. It takes a lot of effort and time to manually examine and predict a lot of data. This study aims to develop a new model that can quickly and accurately predict heart disease using a collection of biological signs. Our cardiovascular disease forecasting system evaluates the predictive algorithms’ ability to classify on mixed datasets using the train-test split technique. Previous studies are contrasted with the proposed method’s training results. Various approaches to comparative analysis and their successful outcomes are explored in this work. The results of this study show that ML algorithms perform better than their human counterparts. Accuracy, recollection, F1-value, misperception matrices, and ROC-AUC curvatures are key performance metrics among the comparative methodologies used. The heart illness dataset yields the best results when using the suggested mixed ML approach, with F1-score, accuracy, precision, and recall all at $\mathbf{1 0 0 \%}$.

articleTitle: Optimizing Multi-Objective Routing with Quantum Firefly Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: There are many different industries that make usage of WSN, which are fundamental to the IoT. The present state of technology has been changed by the Internet of Things. Various kinds of nodes for sensors might be linked by electronic devices that are capable to interact with each other via the Internet, such as recording devices, healthcare devices, and domestic appliances. So, these gadgets can only handle so much data, have so little storage space, and can only be powered when fully charged. Modern society relies heavily on WSN, which finds use in the production of thermal electricity in greenhouses as well, tracking the environment via hydraulic power stations, forest surveillance, and automobile manufacture. Traditional WSNs allow sensor nodes to send unprocessed information to a main hub, there it may be processed and stored. With the latest developments in IoT technology, WSN can now send raw data to fog nodes to be processed, stored, and computed locally, doing away with the requirement to send raw data to centralized servers altogether. Also included is a comprehensive analysis of the QFO-MOSR method in comparison to other methods already in use. The results definitively demonstrate that the QFO-MOSR model outperforms with overall accuracy of 93% compared to FEAR, P-SEP, QACMOR, and AFA in WSN with respect to an total of metrics, which includes energy efficiency, packet delivery ratio, and delay.

articleTitle: Teeth Alignment Prediction Using U-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Orthodontic treatment aims to straighten teeth to improve their appearance and functionality, involving the prediction of teeth alignment to evaluate the patient’s dental structure before treatment. Despite its complexity, advancements in deep learning have enhanced prediction accuracy. The system uses U-Net for precise segmentation of dental images and ResNet for reordering mispositioned teeth, ensuring consistent and reliable alignment predictions. This integration emphasizes the importance of consistency and reliability in assessing teeth alignment, enhancing orthodontic evaluations and streamlining treatment planning, ultimately leading to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: An Effective Implementation and Comparative Analysis of Mobile Robot Path Planning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Among the most pressing and intricate challenges in control and computer engineering today is the navigation of autonomous mobile robots. People are now more motivated than ever to use innovative methods, thanks to the development of cutting-edge computational engineering technology. In order to address complicated engineering challenges in the real world, researchers have mostly looked to natural occurrences and their methods for inspiration. In challenging and dense environments, path planning is the best way of defining a safe route in which a mobile robot can navigate to achieve a certain goal from another location. Mobile robots thus require smart and efficient route planning algorithms for proper navigation and self-execution capabilities. In this study, four well-known algorithms for route planning were investigated: Hybrid DA+CS algorithm: The proposed methods DA, CS and PSO using a non-holonomic mobile robot. To test these methods, a test environment has been created with static impediments which will remain constant throughout the experiment. This is because it is where the intended route of the mobile robot is followed and where the availability of the map acquired for path planning algorithms allows assessing and testing them. A comparative study of the following algorithms has been carried out in an effort to understand the trade off between them based on the conventional performance indicators being used.

articleTitle: Missile Guidance system using Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The proposed system uses the Kalman filter to improve missile trajectory accuracy in various conditions. Guiding systems demonstrate the system’s effectiveness in enhancing the precision and reliability of missile guidance. Integrating Kalman filtering and proportional navigation guidance aims to boost accuracy and resilience. By combining sensor data and predictive algorithms, the system can adjust real-time missile trajectories to counter disturbances and uncertainties. The proposed system consists of three stages: Kalman filtering on noisy target data, implementing the proportional navigation guidance law on clean target data, and maximizing single-shot kill probability by minimizing miss distance. Constant step sizes are employed for both the target and the missile. The miss distance is calculated by interpolating the previous two target positions by a factor of ten and measuring the distance between the missile and the target every 0.1 seconds. The system aims to increase single-shot kill probability by reducing miss distance to approximately 10 meters, a significant improvement in accuracy.

articleTitle: An Efficient Depth Estimation Technique for Visual Perception
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In the realm of computer vision and 3D reconstruction, the accurate conversion of images into depth maps is crucial. This paper focuses on depth estimation techniques to assess their accuracy and reliability in generating depth maps from 2D images. Subsequently, the depth maps were transformed into 3D representations using Open3D in Python, enabling the visualization and reconstruction of three-dimensional scenes. Despite challenges such as noise and artifacts, the reconstruction process yielded promising results, highlighting the potential of image-based 3D reconstruction techniques. This study contributes to the advancement of computer vision technologies by providing insights into improving depth estimation accuracy and enhancing the fidelity of reconstructed 3D models. Additionally, the successful reconstruction of 3D scenes underscores the practical utility of image-based 3D reconstruction methodologies in various domains, including robotics, augmented reality, and autonomous driving.

articleTitle: Hybrid ANFIS Model For Depression Recognition Consuming Three-Channel EEG Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The goal of this effort is to make it more widely used by detecting depression with fewer EEG modes, namely Fp1, Fp2, and Fz. Band power (delta, theta, alpha, and beta) and sub-bands obtained through the selected channels are then used in the research. It also assesses the use of Hybrid ANFIS as well as its variants as classification systems, including GA-ANFIS, PSO-ANFIS, and FA-ANFIS. Filtering and re-referencing to CAR, ICA, and visually are some of the methods used to reduce artifacts and noise in fMRI information. A publicly available information is used in the process, which is then partitioned into a set for training and a testing set. Using ANFIS-GA, this research achieved a high classification accuracy of ${8 5 . 5 9 \%}$, indicating that the suggested framework might be helpful for physicians when detecting depressive disorders. Potentially beneficial uses are demonstrated by the findings, which indicate that depressive disorders may be effectively and easily identified using a minimal number of channels and characteristics. Consequently, the project’s methodology and the implementation of the enhanced hybrid ANFIS systems provide useful data about the use of EEG for depressive disorders diagnosis. Given these findings, it’s reasonable to assume that the suggested technique has the potential to contribute to the enhancement of depressive disorders testing methods.

articleTitle: A Novel Enhanced Cooperative Blackmailing Attack Detection System (Ebad) for SA-CBA Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The integration of collaborative apps has the potential to provide smart city residents a plethora of real-time services. In order to fulfill the many needs of the smart town environment, all of these apps rely on network services that are cognizant of latency. Enhanced technical capabilities are necessary for current processes to function well in smart surroundings. These advancements in the current methods provide a multitude of opportunities for those who would break in. The most dangerous of these infringers is the identification-based assault since it may swiftly undermine the credibility of genuine network components. These intruders want to compromise the allocated unique IDs in order to gain access to the network. This means that present methods of protecting authoritarian regimes against such assaults are ineffective. To combat identity fraud in medical and smart city IoT settings, the Enhanced cooperative blackmailing attack detection (EBAD) method was created. Early identification of Sybil attacker nodes using EBAD may lessen the probability that they will try to undertake a cooperative blackmailing assault. In order to determine if network entities are hostile, the EBAD employs an assessment method based on edge-based allegations. The calculations needed to guarantee the network’s reliability have mostly been offloaded to the edge.

articleTitle: Efficient Novel Method for EEG Signal Classification in Epileptic Seizure Identification using Metaheuristic Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Using a metaheuristic deep learning strategy, the research focuses on the challenge of epileptic seizure detection. A diagnostic tool known as an electroencephalogram (EEG) may detect improperly functioning brain cells, the underlying cause of seizures. To enhance the precision of seizure detection, the offered approach merges deep learning with a metaheuristic optimization technique. This method involves preprocessing raw EEG data in order to extract fundamental characteristics. A classifier that is part of a deep learning system is subsequently fed these characteristics in stages. When it comes to finding a decent solution with high accuracy dimensions, the metaheuristic component finds the optimal values for the deep learning model. Due to the sluggish convergence and trapping of local minima in standard clustering methods, this approach seeks to improve detection performance. Using industry standard EEG datasets, we evaluate our hybrid technique’s performance to that of other relevant models. These findings demonstrate that the system is a dependable tool for real-time seizure detection, with sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy all surpassing the current standards. This method stands head and shoulders above its predecessors, proving its viability for clinical usage in epilepsy monitoring and diagnosis.

articleTitle: Optimizing Multi-Grade Brain Tumor Classification in MRI Images with Hybrid Structure Descriptors: A Detailed Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The work focuses on developing classification models to distinguish the four most common pediatric cerebral tumor types: meningioma, astrocytoma, glioma, and metastases. This tumor kind is hard to see on MRI. Accurately distinguishing meningioma, astrocytoma, glioma, and metastases from MRI data is critical for establishing a surgical plan for tumor excision, since each kind needs distinct activities for a favorable prognosis. The third paper introduces a novel approach to enhance cancer classification accuracy, including meningioma, astrocytoma, glioma, and metastases, utilizing modified multi-texton distribution and hybridization kernel support vector machine methods. Brain tumors develop from uncontrolled cell proliferation. Tumor-forming brain cells surround gland, nerve, and brain membranes. Tumors preferentially destroy brain cells. Ganglioglioma, pilocytic astrocytoma. Slow-growing tumors seem strange under a microscope. Few spreads to adjacent tissues and recur as category high tumors. Rapidly multiplies, looking weirdly on a magnifying glass, and forms brain tissues and arteries. These tumor cells have dead cores. Cancers include GBM. Progressive pre-processing and segmentation may enhance multi-class brain cancer and normal image recognition and categorization. Texture fusion boosts performance. With $\mathbf{9 7 . 4 7 \%}$ accuracy and $\mathbf{9 6 . 0 3 \%}$ sensitivity, HK+FSVM exceeds all other algorithms. The FSVM model is second-best with $\mathbf{9 4 . 7 5 \%}$ accuracy and $\mathbf{9 4 . 4 8 \%}$ sensitivity.

articleTitle: Multi-Plant Leaf Disease Detection and Classification using Convolution Neural Network Aad Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Every nation’s basic need is the agricultural products. Disease-ridden leaves have an effect on the nation’s agricultural output and financial resources. This research provides a deep learning based plant leaf disease classification and detection method. The website (Plant Village dataset) provided the photos that were used. Since tomatoes, peppers, and potatoes are the most prevalent plant species worldwide and in Iraq specifically, we have used them as examples of certain plant species in our study. There are $\mathbf{2 0 6 3 6}$ photos of plants and their illnesses in this data set. Plant leaf diseases are sorted into 15 class labels in the proposed system using a convolutional neural network (CNN). Of these classes, $\mathbf{1 2}$ are dedicated to diseases. Several various plants that were found, including three groups for healthy leaves and various microorganisms including fungus. Consequently, we achieved exceptional precision in both training and testing; specifically, we achieved $\mathbf{9 8. 2 9 \%}$ accuracy in training and $\mathbf{9 8. 0 2 9 \%}$ accuracy in testing across all utilized data sets. Pattern recognition is necessary in order to diagnose these disorders. Using remote sensing techniques to investigate multi- and hyper-spectral picture captures is a frequent approach in this situation. Techniques that use this strategy frequently use digital image processing capabilities to accomplish their objectives. There are numerous kinds of pattern recognition algorithms that provide accurate disease detection. Plant diseases are currently detected using principal component analysis and back propagation. These algorithms are acquired by neural network training supervision.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Power Management Control Scheme for A 9 Bus Grid Tied System Powered by PV System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The internet linked society necessitates the integration of renewable energy supplies and demands in the microgrid with a power management system able to chasing, management and saving energy simultaneously. PV output varies with heat and radiation, necessitating the use of a DC/DC converter to boost PV output. Harmonics in the output are caused by static gadgets in the converter and inverter. This study presents an intelligent power management control method for grid associated system powered by PV system along with Single Ended Primary Inductance Converter (SEPIC) converter. They are executed in an IEEE 9-bus system in a zero inactivity applied state of 100% inverter based generation, where the existence of grid forming inverters is required to validate the model’s functioning also by applying the Cascaded Artificial Neural Network (ANN) controller reduces the harmonics in output. The proposed system has been verified simulations/MATLAB tests. The efficiency comparison of the (SEPIC) converter has the obtain value is 91%.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Grape Leaf Diseases using EfficientNet Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Viticulture or grape cultivation is a significant horticulture method all over the globe. Often, grapevines suffer from many viral, fungal, and bacterial infections that affect production quantity and quality. Farmers worldwide use traditional methods to detect and treat these diseases. However, they are time-consuming, labor intensive, and require significant expertise. The EfficientNetB0 model is implemented for automating the diagnosis of grape leaf diseases. The transfer learning (TL) approach is leveraged to train and fine-tune the EfficientNetB0 model using Kaggle grapevine disease dataset. The leaf image dataset represents four classes - black rot, esca, leaf blight, and healthy samples. The model’s performance is evaluated based on metrics like accuracy and loss. The result shows that EfficientNetB0 gave accuracies of 92.45% and 96.73% on training and validation datasets, respectively. The model achieves better results in disease classification while maintaining computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Automatic Classification of Gastrointestinal Categories from Food Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The meal type, calorie count, and weight are all estimated using a smartphone app. The created software classifies the user as underweight, normal weight, overweight, or obese based on many medical criteria like BMI, etc. The software also sorts foods according to their GI. The software estimates the user’s weight and caloric intake using cloud-based ML. Eating recommendations for optimal nutritional management is another area the app will expand its utility for. The recommendations will take into account a number of underreported dietary characteristics, such as body mass index (BMI), age, sex, food type, eating habits, etc. This study will not only help medical experts make correct diagnoses, but the technology will also be able to supply individuals with self-eating instructions. In areas where healthcare equipment is lacking and expertise is few, this breakthrough will provide a significant answer for the pharmaceutical and wellness sectors. Dietary management programs will also find this product useful for demonstrations and lessons. Reliable scientific tracking of intake categorisation systems by food chews event identification in the portable context is a medically important aspect of this work. The suggested AdaBoost with Random Forest approach achieves much higher accuracy than the other methods when compared to their respective performances. J48-DT delivers good results, KNN improves accuracy, and Naive Bayes performs adequately. The suggested strategy, on the other hand, has an astounding $94.1 \%$ accuracy.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Power Management System for Enhanced Efficiency in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Smart grids are crucial in modern energy systems, integrating sensors, communication networks, and control mechanisms to improve energy distribution. However, conventional methods like Time-Based Scheduling (TBS), Demand Response Mechanism (DRM), and Static Load Distribution (SLD) struggle with inefficiencies such as poor real-time load balancing, limited adaptability, and inaccurate power usage predictions. These drawbacks hinder the overall effectiveness of smart grid systems.To address these challenges, the proposed AI-Driven Power Management System (AI-PMS) leverages machine learning to optimize energy distribution and predict demand more accurately. By using historical and real-time data, AI-PMS dynamically adjusts power flow, ensuring better load distribution and efficiency. This method surpasses the limitations of TBS, DRM, and SLD. The implementation of AI-PMS has resulted in a $0.25 \%$ improvement in energy efficiency and a $0.15 \%$ boost in grid reliability, significantly reducing power losses. The system also enhances the integration of renewable energy sources, making it a more sustainable and adaptive solution for modern smart grids. These advancements promise better power management and lower operational costs for grid operators.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Based Secure Communication Framework For IOMT With Improved Security Via Hybrid Metaheuristic Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Multiple healthcare devices are integrated into an IoMT network to enhance monitoring of patients and real-time treatment. These networks make crucial health care choices using many devices. To protect these devices and networks, researchers have used encoding, hashing, confidentiality safeguarding, attribute-based admittance controller, and more. However, continuous monitoring security frameworks are complicated or unchangeable. Present methods’ security relies on their interior setup, which is seldom extendable for new assaults. This explore recommends a hybrid metaheuristic approach for health care IoT safety. Changing encryption and hashing standards may dynamically rearrange the blockchain paradigm. EHO and GWO are used to continually optimize blockchain-based IoMT implementation security and QoS performance. In the proposed paradigm, dual fitness functions increase safety and QoS for numerous attacks. Fitness functions adjust encryption and hashing settings to enhance performance against various attacks. Blockchain-based deployment may be scaled and used in real time by integrating EH and GW optimization models for dynamic attack situations. The prototypical is evaluated beneath masquerade, Sybil, MITM, and DDoS assaults and associated to leading models.

articleTitle: Smart Portable ECG and SPO2 Kit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The electrical activity of the heart is measured and recorded using an electrocardiogram, often known as an EKG or ECG. Cardiac arrhythmia signifies an abnormal heart rate or rhythm. The proposed health monitoring system is a comprehensive, portable solution designed to monitor key cardiovascular indicators specifically, heart rate and blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) in real-time. The system integrates two microcontrollers: an Arduino Mega and a Node MCU. The Arduino Mega is responsible for displaying ECG waveforms on a TFT screen, as well as calculating and displaying the heart rate. This is achieved through an ECG sensor connected to the Arduino, which plots the heart’s electrical activity on the display. A potentiometer allows users to set a customizable threshold line on the ECG waveform, which is used to count heartbeats. The heart rate is calculated based on the number of beats detected per second. If the heart rate falls below or rises above the normal range, the system alerts the user by displaying “Bradycardia” or “Tachycardia,” respectively. Meanwhile, the Node MCU module is connected to a MAX30100 sensor, which measures SpO2 levels. The sensor data is wirelessly transmitted to the Arduino Mega, where it is displayed on the TFT screen alongside the ECG data.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System Using Machine Learning Based on NSL KDD Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Todays digital era network may become unstable due to malicious activity on the Internet. One of the best protection methods is an intrusion detection system (IDS), which lowers security losses and shields you from online threats. One method of identifying irregularities in network traffic is the detection of invasion. The challenge of cybersecurity has grown along with the number of devices linked to the Internet. Any harmful behavior on the network must be identified right away in order to guarantee the confidentiality, availability, and integrity of user data. IDS employs machine learning algorithms, which are utilized in anomaly detection techniques to identify network attacks, to address this issue. This study classified the data as either normal or intrusive using machine learning (ML) classifiers, including Random Forest (RF), Extra Tree Classifier (ETC), and Decision Tree (DT). Four variables from the NSL-KDD dataset—a publicly available dataset for identifying DoS, Probe, R2L, and U2R attacks—were used to forecast the model’s performance.

articleTitle: A Novel Simulated Annealing-based Algorithm for Data Replication Optimization in Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: New issues such network congestion, capacity limitation, and excessive latency have arisen due to the everincreasing need for efficiently processing complex data in MEC systems. Improving system performance, lowering latency, or increasing data availability are all possible outcomes of data replication, which entails making several copies of data at the edge nodes. Data replication and placement in MEC systems is hardly a walk in the park, either, since mobile networks are always evolving. An article introducing a heuristic Data Replication Algorithm (SA-DRA) based on Simulated Annealing that is particular to MEC is presented now. Therefore, SA-DRA’s goal is to delay replication until it returns maximum benefit while simultaneously eliminating the use of available network resources. Multiple elements or measurements may be used for this purpose, such as user mobility, network design, and workload kinds. A new solution is first generated using a basic formula, and then a cost function depending on the network status in real mode is used. Sequential operation of surrounding states exploration in a cycle improves the position even farther than the initial result. To find out how much more efficient SA-DRA is at tackling latency and load balancing between edge nodes, we compared the simulated results to those of using heuristics and greed.

articleTitle: Effective Smart Bin Monitoring System using Arduino and GSM Module
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Effective waste management is a significant challenge in urban/rural environments, driven by increasing population density and waste generation. This paper aims to enhance the management of urban/rural waste by automating the separation of waste wet and dry and streamlining the sorting procedure. To guarantee correct waste sorting at the source, the system combines real-time monitoring and automation with timely notifications for collection. Wet sensors are used to identify wet and dry waste; ultrasonic sensors are used to measure bin fill levels and empty levels; servo motors are used for automated segregation; GSM modules are used for communication; and microcontroller (such as an Arduino UNO) is used to coordinate the system. The project’s outcomes demonstrate exact waste segregation, continuous empty-bin alarms, and real-time bin-level monitoring.

articleTitle: Integrating Machine Learning and Swarm Intelligence for Enhanced Incongruity Recognition in Dense Crowds
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Autonomous behavior detection in surveillance footage and the proliferation of monitoring networks are two areas where smart city and public safety initiatives are placing a premium on technological advancements. Using context modeling, new methods for object movement recognition have been developed. Sound and background movement are let in because current anomaly detection algorithms only consider geographical data and completely or partially ignore temporal data. The huge number of people in a scene causes noticeable variations in movement and appearance, making it difficult to monitor individual subjects.An technique to anomaly detection is created using machine learning along with swarm intelligence. This approach extracts spatiotemporal information from video sequences. Effective tracking and detection of anomalous items is achieved by extracting prominent characteristics from the frames in this technique. The first step is to build a two-dimensional variance plane that can capture the local spatiotemporal fluctuations within each of the pixels in a video frame. The most important areas are located using motion data in the two-dimensional variance plane and the Enhanced Particle Swarm Optimization method. The selected important video pixels are then subjected to a GLCM. In order to acquire highlevel info for anomalous event identification with more precision, a classifier based on an Enhanced Neural Network is used. Tracking accuracy suffers in low-quality footage and when objects are obstructing the view, however the anomaly detecting process is very clear.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection and Stage Classification Using Lenet-5Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy diagnosis and treatment are made possible through retinal screening. To process the retinal screening, we are developing a deep learning system to detect and classify diabetic retinopathy.If it is not diagnosed treated it may lead to other serious eye infection like macular edema and glaucoma ultimately causing loss of eye sight. In contrasting to manually created features, we employed the convolutional neural networks (CNN) model i.e Lenet-5 architecture to automatically extract features. Methodologies like edge detection, thresholding and data augmentation are applied to the system during error checking. The efficiency of the system is assessed using statistical metrics like sensitivity (SE), specificity (SP), F-measure, and classification accuracy (ACC).The model achieved an average accuracy of 97%,recall of 22% and f1-score of 65%.

articleTitle: Integrative Predictive Analytics: A Multi-Algorithm Approach to Simultaneous Diabetes and Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Diabetes has grown to a pandemic proportion worldwide; using the most recent statistics available in 2021, it was found that 537 million people suffer from diabetes, with the number continuing to grow. This chronic health disease appears if the body either cannot produce sufficient insulin or is unable to use it correctly and safely. Symptoms may include increased thirst, urination, tiredness, and blurred vision. The major causes of diabetes revolve around the central issues of dietary habits and lack of physical activity, though it can be genetic too. Complications involving damage to kidney function, amputation, and even blindness are potential consequences. Diabetic complications in the eye manifest through the pathological condition called diabetic retinopathy. The symptoms include, but are not limited to, blurred vision and dark spots in the visual field; diabetic retinopathy can further cause night blindness.

articleTitle: Mitigating Cyber Threats in WSNs: An Enhanced DBN-Based Approach with Data Balancing via SMOTE-Tomek and Sparrow Search Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs), which include both fixed and moving sensors, are essential building blocks of cyberphysical systems. Each of these sensors senses, gathers, processes, and transmits data about their environment; they also self-organise and communicate via multi-hop links. Notwithstanding their importance, WSNs are vulnerable to damaging assaults that can interrupt operations in an instant. Current approaches to intrusion detection in WSNs face problems including false alarms, computational overhead, and low detection rates. High network correlation, data redundancy, and limited resources at sensor nodes are the root causes of these problems. But being linked to the IoT makes them susceptible to attackers. This study utilises a machine learning approach, specifically the Deep Belief Network (DBN) algorithm, to address the challenges of WSN intrusion detection. The algorithm is used to the input dataset to identify binary and multi-class attacks. Also, the input data is balanced using the SMOTE-TomekLink technique, which stands for Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique Tomek Link. The balanced dataset that results from this blend’s synthesis of minority instances and elimination of Tomek linkages greatly improves WSN detection accuracy. to use the SMOTE-Tomek resampling method to address imbalanced WSN datasets, which helps to reduce the impact of overfitting and underfitting. To maximise the network’s precision, the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) chooses the SMOTE’s sampling rate. to find the best model for WSN intrusion detection by doing a thorough evaluation utilising the WSN-DS dataset, which has 374,661 records. The outstanding performance of our model stands out as the key result of our research. Our proposal’s success in identifying and mitigating intrusions in WSNs is demonstrated by these data, which emphasise its efficiency and superiority in the context of WSN intrusion detection.

Author Keywords: Synthetic Minority Oversampling Procedure Tomek Link

articleTitle: Design and Development of Metamaterial based RF Resonator for Ultrawideband Sensor Applications for Patient Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This work intends to characterize the design and fabrication of a radio frequency (RF) resonator using metamaterials for ultra-wideband (UWB) sensor applications with particular attention on patient monitoring systems. The proposed design makes perfect electric conductor (PEC) for the ground plane and patch components as well as FR-4 as the substrate material-selected for its exceptional balance between cost and electrical properties. Incorporating metamaterials into the patch antenna improves performance. It aims especially to improve bandwidth, sensitivity, and compactness-qualities essential for UWB sensor operation. By means of simulations covering a frequency range from 0.5 GHz to 12 GHz, two main S-parameter curves were produced: $-\mathbf{- 3 7} \mathrm{dB}$ at 5.225 GHz and 38 dB at 5.9075 GHz, so displaying significant reflection characteristics at these sites. The antenna was $100 \%$ efficient within the given frequency range, so confirming its ability to transmit and receive signals. Strong signal transmissions define reliable communication in sensor systems; hence, the dumbbellshaped radiation pattern also suggests strong signal transmissions. Addition of complementary split ring resonators (CSRRs) to the resonator enhanced its electromagnetic properties, so improving signal efficiency and extending the frequency range. These developments make the RF resonator particularly suitable for real-time physiological monitoring comprising tracking of heart rate and breathing rhythm. Particularly in patient monitoring, the results of this work show that metamaterial-based RF resonators can help to create small, dependable UWB sensors with great promise for medical uses.

articleTitle: Hybrid Edge-Cloud Approach for Renewable Energy Management Using Deep Learning with Predictive Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy sources into smart grids requires advanced management systems to optimize energy production, storage, and distribution. Conventional methods like Static Energy Allocation (SEA) and Rule-Based Control (RBC) struggle with real-time adaptability, leading to inefficiencies in handling the variable nature of renewable energy. SEA and RBC lack the predictive capabilities needed to effectively manage dynamic energy generation, resulting in increased energy losses and operational costs.This paper proposes a Hybrid Edge-Cloud Renewable Energy Management System (HECREMS) using Deep Learning with Predictive Analytics (DLPA). HECREMS integrates edge computing for real-time data processing with cloud computing for enhanced predictive analytics, providing a robust framework for efficient energy management. The proposed system leverages the low latency of edge devices and the computational power of the cloud to improve energy forecasting and decision-making. HECREMS outperforms traditional SEA and RBC methods, achieving a $0.25 \%$ improvement in energy utilization efficiency, a $\mathbf{0. 2 0 \%}$ reduction in operational costs, and a $0.30 \%$ increase in system responsiveness. By addressing the drawbacks of conventional approaches, HECREMS demonstrates significant advancements in the efficient and sustainable management of renewable energy within smart grids.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Medical Imaging: Bridging the Gap between 2D Processing and Interactive 3D Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This paper mainly aims to present the use of transform a 2D image into a 3D interactive model which will help us visualize the anomaly, allowing the medical sector a better understanding of anomalies in medical images, which may even unearth new findings. Using stable diffusion algorithms, the generative model and computer vision converts 2D images into interactive 3D models. Existing structures usually struggle with complex 2D images when the anomaly is detected, hence focus on building a 3D model for deeper understanding is necessary. In this model, the challenges and roadblocks in normal 2D images for anomaly detection and why a 3D model will provide a better insight into the anomaly from medical images is discussed. Next, it explores the technological benefits of having an advanced 3D model and how the 3D model will help in interacting with the anomaly by employing 3D models to show the expected progression in the anomaly extraction process. Finally outlining the previously implemented models to generate 3D interactive objects such as, generative adversarial networks (GANs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs), as they have exhibited promising results in extracting meaningful features and detecting anomalies in medical images. It emphasizes the importance of bridging the gap between 2D image processing and interactive 3D visualization in anomaly by incorporating advanced techniques, leveraging 3D information, and enabling interactive exploration, that enhance the precision and efficacy of anomaly detection, aiding in achieving quicker diagnosis and treatment as outcomes in healthcare.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing Based Intrusion Detection Interface For IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The “Natural language processing based intrusion detection interface for IoT devices” project aims to develop a system to detect intrusions (security threats) in Internet of Things (IoT) devices that have been compromised. The technology analyzes data from Internet of Things (IoT) devices using Natural Language Processing (NLP), making it easier and simpler to identify and explain threats. One big challenge with IoT devices is that they generate a lot of different types of data, which makes it hard in terms of threat detection. Our project solves this by processing this data using natural language processing (NLP) to process this data and provide clear, easy-to-understand instructions for users to respond to potential security threats. This way, even those without technical expertise can understand the system’s alerts and take action. The system is designed to operate on low-power Internet of Things(IoT) devices, which means it can function efficiently without consuming a lot of resources. Additionally, it will continue to pick up knowledge from the material it examines, keeping it informed about emerging risks. All things considered, the technology offers consumers effective and straightforward IoT device protection (Explainable IoT IDS)

articleTitle: Advanced AI Solution for Dynamic PDF Interaction and Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The system aims to simplify the process of interaction with PDFs. Developed using Next.js 14, Shaden, UploadThings, Pinecone, Prisma, Postgresql and Langchain framework, it enables users to upload PDFs of up to 16MB, overcoming limitations seen in other platforms offering similar services. Once uploaded, users can query questions related to the PDF, and an implemented OpenAI model generates relevant answers. In cases where the OpenAI model fails to locate information, it provides appropriate responses, informing the user of its inability to find the requested information. Furthermore, the platform prioritizes user privacy and security. Users have the capability to delete both the uploaded PDFs and associated chat interactions. This feature ensures that sensitive information remains under the user’s control, offering peace of mind regarding data privacy. By leveraging advanced technologies and frameworks, the systemt streamlines PDF interaction, offering users a seamless experience. Whether it’s retrieving specific information from PDF documents or managing privacy preferences, the platform empowers users with efficient tools and functionalities.

articleTitle: A Method for Predicting Cardiovascular Disorder using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Drastic increase of cardiovascular disease has led to a lot of adult’s death. As per “News 18” very year, 12 million young people in India die from heart disease. In most of these cases people experience cardiac arrest, some of which are normal. First, families of patients are vulnerable because it takes only a few minutes for a person to die of a heart attack, and it is difficult to get medical help in time. Second, most victims are under the age of 45. According to Dr. Maninder Sandhu, cardiologist and cardiologist at Artemis Hospital Gurgaon, 30 percent of people who suffer from heart disease are under the age of 45. This paper proposes a method that maybe used by laboratory technicians, doctors and users to understand whether there are any chances of having cardiovascular disease or not. The proposed system takes live data of patients and their lifestyle attributes these data are processed by the trained model to produce the output. In this model we haveused random forest classifier, linear regression, $\mathbf{k}$-neighbors classifier & x gradient boost classifier. This model has attained maximum accuracy and least type one error in “X- Gradient Boost”. We have concentrated more on type one error. The developed system shows whether the patient has any chances of cardiovascular disease or not.

articleTitle: Optimization of Integrated Optical Microring Resonators for Enhanced Sensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This research introduces an innovative integrated optical microring resonator (IOMR) tailored for a variety of sensing applications, with a particular emphasis on force sensing. And the study utilizes the Finite-Difference-TimeDomain (FDTD) method to fine-tune essential parameters, including the widths of the microring and bus waveguides, as well as the coupling gap. The resulting optimized IOMR exhibits an impressive quality factor (Q-factor) of $\mathbf{1 8, 2 4 1}$ and free measurement tool. The microring, characterized by a radius of $5 \mu \mathrm{~m}$ and a thickness of 220 nm, is integrated into a microcantilever beam (MCB) to amplify its responsiveness to external forces. The sensor functions based on the photo-elastic effect, where variations in the effective refractive index occur in response to applied forces, resulting in a measurable shift in the resonant wavelength. The sensitivity of the force sensor is quantified at 5 pm per $1 \mu \mathrm{~N}$, with a detection range extending from 0 to $1 \mu \mathrm{~N}$. This study underscores the potential applications of optimized IOMRs in various fields, including pressure, acceleration, and biosensing.

articleTitle: Enhancing Supply Chain Efficiency with IoT and Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This study aims at exploring the use of internet of things technology and data analytics in the field of supply chain management. Using a range of software tools, including Apache Kafka, Apache NiFi, Python libraries such as Pandas, and Scikit-learn, the study accumulated, assimilated, and quantified data from IoT sensors, supply chain systems, and qualitative interviews. The primary data sources are primary supply chain data history and IoT sensor data while secondary data includes academic and industrial journals, and reports. This paper presents a number of basic quantitative measures showing the general performance indicators: the average percentage of order fulfilment as $\mathbf{9 2. 5 \%}$ and the inventory turnover ratio equalling 6.2. When using linear regression, random forest, and LSTM neural network, the models reveal the mean absolute errors of demand forecasting between 80 and $\mathbf{1 2 0}$ units. The results suggest that IoT and data analysis offer significant opportunities to create value through the integration of SC, cost cutting, and higher customer satisfaction. It has now become essential for organizations to effectively apply data trends to enable competitive gains within the complex business setting to foster operational efficacy and stability.

articleTitle: Enhancing Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis Using Intelligent Images Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Diabetic is insulin resistance that causes abnormal blood sugar regulation in human beings and damages the kidney, heart, eye, and nerve systems. Retinopathy is the study of retina in organ eyes, which explains the damage that happened to the small blood vessels in the retina. This may cause impaired vision in human. Diabetic patients who are suffering from retinopathy may have blindness. Therefore, it is necessary to detect diabetic retinopathy (DR) stages at an appropriate time. Machine learning algorithms help to categorize diabetic retinopathy stages from retinal images. Thus, the research work on classification helps the doctors to detect diabetic retinopathy. The authors of this article present the novel algorithm Synergistic Image Compression and Feature Extraction (SI COMFEX) for classifying retinal images. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Visual Geometry Group 16 (VGG16) machine learning algorithms or models are configured for multiclass classification. These models successfully classify retinal images into different classes such as mild, moderate, No DR, Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy (PDR) and severe. The authors of this paper have also compared the designed SI COMFEX algorithm with CNN and VGG16. The performances of the models are verified using Precision, Recall and F1 Score parameters. The comparative study shows that SI COMFEX gives 65.31% testing accuracy, which is better than VGG16 and 10% lower than CNN model.

articleTitle: SC-CNN: Advancing Corn Crop Disease Classification - A Comparative Study with CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In this study, the effectiveness and performance of the Skip-Connected Convolutional Neural Network (SC-CNN) architecture for image classification tasks are evaluated against that of a traditional Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Inspired by the U-Net model, SC-CNN integrates skip connections to enable seamless feature propagation across layers, addressing challenges like vanishing gradients. Through a meticulous evaluation encompassing metrics, training efficiency, complexity analysis, and feature map visualization, we scrutinize SC-CNN’s effectiveness. Our findings highlight SC-CNN’s competitive performance and interpretability advantages. Notably, by achieving a 0.17% increase in accuracy, it appears that SC-CNN slightly outperforms CNN. This research fosters a deeper understanding of skip-connected architectures in image classification and their broader applicability in computer vision tasks.

articleTitle: Exploring Reinforcement Learning Algorithms for Autonomous Agents in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms are widely considered to be the enabling technology for deep learning and allow for agents in complex systems to learn in a dynamic environment. In order to present in this paper a break-through training methodology for learning RL agents in the dynamic environment, advised by the following adaptability, robustness, and scalability purposes. Our approach is assessed in an array of the model environments which are open to the users. This framework is labelled as OpenAI Gym environment. We apply different reinforcement learning algorithms in our experiments among which Covering Concurrent and Differentiable in Q-learning, Meta-learning (MAML), Virtual Imitation and Q-learning, and Dyna-Q are the most popular. Meta-learning’s performance highlights its power and efficiency in grasping and optimizing decision-making logic in dynamic situations within 20 epochs and reaching the cumulative reward of 500. As a matter of fact, adaptive search strategies, for instance, UCB are another tool that is extremely useful reaching to 490 at 25 epochs after all. Transfer learning techniques like the Progressive Neural Networks shows extremely high power of learning in collecting a reward of 500 and in less than 20 epochs it also converges. Moreover, scalable parallel training methods such as CPDG which are normalized in distribution, have huge scalability and robustness can be applied for large scale dynamic environments. Consequently, it is concluded that the presented approach was very good in giving RL agents the ability to navigate environments and succeed in dynamic settings, thus contributing to the development of autonomous systems not only in the area of RL but also everywhere else.

articleTitle: 5G-Enabled Remote Healthcare Monitoring for Improved Patient Care
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The implementation of 5G technology boosts the possibility of the remote monitoring in healthcare to the above and beyond while providing new capabilities like data transmission speed, connectivity, and reliability. The contribution of this study aims to cover the application of 5 G network in healthcare monitoring systems in order to improve patient care, whereby, it considers integration of devices, real time data processing, AI and machine learning, security, scalability and telemedicine. Our approach covers setting up an advanced focus network propose, adopting IoT based health protocols devices, employing edge process, combining with AI purpose of predictive model, and consuming advanced security protocols. Stepping stone trial proved that patient response time, alert accuracy, user satisfaction, as well as data processing performance is greatly enhanced. Implementation AI/ML features increased predictive accuracy and improving capability to detect anomalies thus improving the overall robotic control systems. These results display imposing enhancement in effectiveness, steadiness, and scalability of a system. At the same time, we present this system with the highest level of data security and privacy. Integrative orientation pinpoints 5G-emboldened remote health-care monitoring as one of the major ways to deliver effective and streamlined patient care.

articleTitle: Local Meet: Utilizing Video and Audio Conferences in Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In today’s modern age, communication can be challenging when individuals or groups are not physically nearby. Hence, digital communication has become indispensable in our daily lives, facilitating interactions through video calls, phone calls, or chats across various platforms. The proposed model aims to enhance digital communication among local individuals using a local meeting framework. Its key features encompass video and audio calls, screen sharing, chat functionality, and the ability to schedule or host meetings. The envisioned application focuses on video conferencing, leveraging WebRTC, a free and open-source project that empowers web browsers and mobile apps with real-time communication capabilities via APIs. Through Local Meet, browsers can directly exchange real-time media in a peer-to-peer manner, ensuring heightened security compared to other streaming systems, all without the need for third-party software. Additionally, the proposed system includes mechanisms to alert groups about network connectivity issues, particularly when the network fails to support the required bandwidth. It is primarily designed for online classes and discussions on various subjects. Additionally, Local Meet assists organizers in tracking attendance and saving the information discussed during sessions.

articleTitle: Computer Vision for Agricultural Automation - Algorithmic Solutions for Crop Yield Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract:
Computer vision is defined in this study and one of the applications demonstrated is crop yield prediction in agricultural automation. Here we have emphasized on its use for computer vision for the agricultural domain. Using multispectral images that can be obtained from drones satellites and pairs with ground truths of average crop yield, weather conditions and parts of the soil treated with practices performed by an agronomist the proffered methodology would take advantage of the uniqueness of the concept to predict crop production. Further, elaborate machine learning methods such as line regression, decision trees, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine and CNN models are applied in order that the ultimate selection of the model would be contingent on the accuracy in relation to a crop yield.
