articleTitle: Lip Movement Detection in Konkani Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Lip reading, which uses visual lip movements to identify spoken words, is essential for improving communication. To precisely detect and analyze lip movements, this presents a hybrid deep learning model in this study that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Units (Bi-GRU). This method is based on real-time video input, wherein a Bi- GRU model is used to capture temporal dependencies after the mouth region has been identified and processed through a CNN to extract spatial characteristics. Using Konkani language datasets for training and evaluation, the model achieves strong word recognition accuracy. The system shows a significant improvement in lip-reading accuracy by incorporating both the spatial and temporal components of lip motions, which makes it suitable for assistive communication technologies and automatic speech recognition.

articleTitle: Design and Development of LIDAR Based Next Generation Embedded system for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Efficient communication between vehicles is crucial for improving road safety and optimizing traffic flow. This paper presents a novel Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication system using LIDAR sensors and a LiFi-based protocol, integrated with microcontrollers and interactive displays. The proposed system is designed for small autonomous electric vehicles, incorporating an embedded communication framework and a collision-avoidance algorithm to enhance safety. In addition, a platooning control system is developed, enabling seamless vehicle communication for coordinated driving, including handling vehicle interferences and separations.The primary goal of this system is to establish a real-time communication network between vehicles, allowing them to exchange alerts, messages, and traffic updates without relying on infrastructure-based traffic control methods. Unlike traditional systems, which often lack adaptability and coverage, this decentralized approach offers increased flexibility and scalability. Experimental results from multiple platooning configurations of small electric vehicles demonstrate the system’s effectiveness in improving vehicle coordination and reducing traffic-related incidents.

articleTitle: Music Genre Detection Using Audio Streams: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In the current digital age, the proliferation of music libraries and streaming services has led to an overwhelming abundance of musical content. Automated music genre detection is crucial for enhancing user experience through personalized recommendations, improved search functionalities, and dynamic playlist generation. Traditional genre classification methods re- liant on metadata are becoming impractical due to the vast volume of new music. Machine learning and artificial intelligence present promising solutions by leveraging advanced algorithms to discern patterns in audio files corresponding to different genres. This paper explores usage machine learning techniques on the GTZAN dataset for music genre detection. Models like Naive Bayes, SVM, Decision Trees, Random Forest, and Neural Networks are evaluated, Maximum accuracy has been achieved with CatBoost classifier (0.90524) and XGBoost Classifier (0.91058). Data preprocessing and PCA demonstrate significant improvements in accuracy. This study contributes insights into effective genre classification methods, benefiting listeners and music industry professionals.

articleTitle: Impact of Different Embeddings on Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Text representation has consistently posed significant challenges in the field of natural language processing. Features such as frequency, position in the text, and co-occurrence of words are used extensively to design various text representation techniques. There are different techniques currently used for text representation. Some are the Bag of words, TF-IDF, Word2vec, GloVe, and FastText. Normally, frequency-based text representations, which convert each word to a single number, are paired with machine learning algorithms, while context-based word embeddings that convert each word to n-dimensional vectors are used with neural network classifiers. This paper examines both frequency and context-based word embeddings on multiple machine learning and neural network-based classifiers and compares the results. The experimental results conclude that Bag of words and TF-IDF (frequency-based) have higher accuracy with ML classifiers such as Logistic Regression and decision tree; Word2vec, GloVe, and Fast Text (context-based) have performed extremely well for neural network-based classifiers such as LSTM, DNN, and GRU.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optimized Intrusion Detection System Using Auto-Encoder and Extreme Learning Machine for Enhanced Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The safety of our networks and the communications to use on a daily basis depends on them. In order to provide safe networks, cybersecurity researchers are highlighting the importance of new, effective intrusion detection systems (IDS). The need for effective IDS grows as attackers continue to create new types of assaults and network sizes continue to grow. By thwarting unauthorised access to the network, IDS also strives to provide availability, integrity, and confidentiality for data sent in networked computers. Machine learning (ML) systems to re used in a number of studies to develop effective IDS; however, researchers began to rely on deep learning (DL) methods when ANNs to reintroduced, which generate features automatically and without human intervention. In order to clean up the input data, this study presents a min-max normalisation approach. Then, a hybrid optimiser called LBOA, which combines Butterfly Optimisation and Lion Optimiser, selects the most relevant characteristics using a deep learning-based Auto-encoder (AE). Lastly, Extreme learning machine (ELM) uses the attributes that to re picked to identify assaults on network traffic. For this aim, to use the UNSW-NB15 dataset, which contains four types of attacks, and the suggested model got an accuracy of around 97%. The suggested method outperforms competing models, according on the comparison findings.

articleTitle: Solar Harmoni Air: The Integration of Solar Power for Intelligent Outdoor Air Purification and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The escalating global concerns over air pollution necessitate innovative solutions to mitigate its adverse effects on public health and the environment. In response, we present a pioneering solar-powered air purifier integrated with an advanced air quality monitoring system. An outdoor air purifier with dual sensors capable of detecting various pollutants, including ammonia, sulphide, benzene, smoke, and carbon monoxide, is developed. The system activates its filtration mechanisms when air quality falls below certain thresholds, utilizing a two-tiered filtration system comprising pre-filter and fine filter layers, effectively reducing volatile organic compound (VOC) pollutants. Real-time monitoring and effective purification capabilities, achieving purification levels ranging approximately from 70% to 80%, were accomplished. This innovative solution offers a comprehensive approach to addressing air quality concerns in outdoor environments, providing efficient purification capabilities and operating for up to 14 hours a day.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning Approaches for Personalized Medical Image Analysis: Revolutionizing Healthcare with Precision Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Awareness of high precision deep learning in personalized medical image analysis can be regarded as a portend of a new healthcare paradigm shift by making a breakthrough in diagnostic accuracy, treatment effect, and the prognosis of diseases. This work is the description of the entire procedure that incorporates techniques that are perfectly for location trying to put into consideration the inherent challenges and opportunities in this profession. Applying enriched datasets with modern state-of-the-art deep learning architectures that include CNN’s (convolutionneural networking), RNN’s (recurrent neural networking), and hybrid models enables our approach to have higher performance across several tasks, among them is image segmentation, disease classification and lesion detection. A feasibility study in real clinical settings shows that these deep learning models improve the patient care pathway, ease the use for doctors, and integrate into the existing health care organizations very well. On top of that, performance evaluation indicators emphasize to what extent our models are scalable, resourced, and efficient which is in a turn ensures timely and accurate interpretation of medical imagery..The performance of our approach never stops with the improvement systems and the measure that make it better each time, and it would be perfect for future development of more enduring precision medicine. The use of basement advanced deep learning methodologies renders it possible to liberate the inner heights of the individualized medical image analysis, which in result translates into the whole world change of medical care delivery and the improvement of patient care worldwide.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Dual-Circular Element Antenna for High Frequency Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: There is a growing demand for antennas with high efficiency, compact design and low return loss while operating at high frequencies in modern wireless communication systems Current antenna designs face many challenges in optimizing performance to be achieved in these dimensions due to material limitations and complex geometries The paper proposes a new smart antenna design using Perfect Electric Conductor (PEC) materials to overcome these issues. The antenna incorporates dual circular slots in the rectangular PEC substrate, aimed at improving impedance matching, reducing power losses, and increasing radiation efficiency Simulated in CST Microwave Studio, the antenna is efficient at microwave frequency range, in consequence Featuring significant improvements in gain, bandwidth and restoration loss this system offers a robust solution to the challenges encountered in wireless power transmission and high- frequency communications systems,. and provides a compact and efficient alternative to the conventional antenna system

articleTitle: Evaluating Deep Neural Networks for the Classification and Identification of Medicinal Plant Species
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: It is essential to comprehend medicinal plant species in order to safeguard and preserve biodiversity. These plants require complex, intensive processes for their classification and identification, which are usually overseen by botanical specialists. The goal of this systematic review is to provide a comprehensive assessment of earlier studies on the use of deep learning methods for the identification and categorization of species of medicinal plants. By revolutionizing plant classification, deep neural networks (DNNs) have made substantial advancements in crop yield protection and agricultural risk management. Eight therapeutic plants are recognized and categorized in the suggested system with the use of DNN models, and important assessment metrics including F1 score, recall, accuracy, and precision are also calculated. This method produces subtle insights that make it easier to distinguish between therapeutic plants.

articleTitle: Balancing Performance and Protection: A Study of Speed-Security Trade-offs in Video Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The paper discusses about the critical balance between speed and security in video content protection, highlighting the trade-offs involved in maintaining both. As digital video con tent becomes increasingly integral to various applications, such as streaming, surveillance, and conferencing, it faces growing security threats like unauthorized access and piracy. To address these, robust security measures like encryption, access control, and watermarking are employed. However, these measures often introduce latency and processing overhead, potentially affecting video performance. The paper examines various security techniques and their impact on speed, exploring how advancements in technology, such as adaptive bitrate streaming, AI-driven optimization, and blockchain, can help mitigate these challenges. It also provides case studies on platforms like Netflix and YouTube, which illustrate the successful implementation of speed-security trade-offs. The paper concludes by emphasizing the importance of ongoing research and innovation to achieve an optimal balance between video security and performance, ensuring that content remains protected without compromising user experience.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Healthcare with Wearable Devices and IoT Integration for Personalized Health Management in Next-Generation Health Informatics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This work outlines a paradigm shift that is created by the integration of wearable devices with the Internet of Things for health consciousness. With the help of the proposed system, the user is given the constant readings of the key heath indicators including heart rate, blood pressure, blood glucose level, physical activity, and the quality of sleep, all the data are transferred in real-time to an IoT platform, and the data analysis supported by machine learning algorithms provide the user with individually tailored heath reports. Wearable Medical today carried out a 90 persons trial over a six-month long program and noted changes in health parameters, user interactions and results. Several client outcomes highlighted that clients’ heart rate, blood pressure and glucose levels, physical activity, and sleep quality improved. The system also provided strong control in data protection and the compliance with different regulations which is needed for any company. Although there are issues with device and network integration and the supporting architecture, the study demonstrates the system’s capability of decreasing hospital attendance, increasing medication compliance and quality of life, thereby opening up possibilities for exploring wearable health technologies in clinical environments in the future.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity in the Digital Age with Machine Learning for Threat Detection and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Information security cannot be underemphasized today especially with the increased use of Information Communication Technology which requires improved threat identification techniques. In this study, we propose a novel methodology comprising four variants—CyberShield, SentinelGuard, ThreatHunter, and SecureNet—and evaluate their performance against existing approaches in terms of key performance metrics: which are efficiency, precision, recall, F1-score and AUC. In all variants above experiments that we had demonstrated, there is rather more distinctive feature towards threat identifiers guaranteed other than what is presently offered. Interestingly, CyberShield with +3.8% and ThreatHunter with +3.8%, both the highest, are more accurate in terms of classifications of cyper-attacks than other algorithms. Finally, all proposed variants are ranked higher than the current approaches in terms of recall with possible variation between 4.2% and 2.2 for TP rates, meaning these approaches have the potential to minimize false negatives. In addition, the advance variants actually cause slight increase in Precision and F1-Score but with aids to make Precision equivalent to Recall, the achieved performance is relatively higher. What this would do is expose the advantages of the new proposed variants in terms of the degree of influence human behavior and the rate of risk of cyber threats.

articleTitle: SafeMeds: A Blockchain-Driven Drug Supply Chain Verification System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Innovative steps are required to secure the drug supply chain since public health is in danger due to the increase in pharmaceutical drug counterfeiting. The goal of this work is to use blockchain technology to combat the pervasive issue of false medications and improve temperature-controlled distribution security in the pharmaceutical industry. The increasing entry of tainted pharmaceuticals onto the market, which endangers patient security and erodes confidence in global systems of healthcare, emphasizes how urgent this undertaking is. The primary objective of this initiative is to develop a reliable and transparent blockchain-based system to ensure the authenticity and traceability of pharmaceutical products throughout their entire lifecycle, from production to distribution. By utilizing the decentralized and unchangeable ledger of blockchain technology, the system will enable instantaneous tracking and validation of the provenance of every medicine, guaranteeing safeguards against manipulation and counterfeiting. To maintain the integrity of temperature-sensitive PharmaChain Distribution, the implementation will also give priority to improving cold chain distribution by incorporating temperature-integrating sensors for humidity into the blockchain.

articleTitle: A Deep Multi-View Learning Approach for Wildlife Animal Detection and Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Detecting animals and recognizing them is a challenging task in computer vision. The main aim of this paper is to detect the animals in an image from the selected datasets and assign a label to each of the corresponding images. The images are selected from different databases under different conditions. In this work, detection and recognition are done with the help of Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and a Deep residual network, which can overcome error rates in the existing methods due to high false positive and negative rates. The proposed work is compared with existing methodologies such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Multi- Layer Perceptron (MLP). In the present approach, PCA is used to create views in the given image for identification and deep residual network is used to alleviate the lack of labeled training samples in order to identify a learned latent space. The results are demonstrated and analyzed on varied datasets using different evaluation metrics. In comparison to other algorithms, the proposed work exhibits enhanced accuracy by 2.27-4.00%.

articleTitle: Designing Neuro-Inspired Architectures for Efficient Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Communication systems, picture and voice recognition, and data analysis are just a few examples of how signal processing has impacted other areas of contemporary technology. In this research, we compare a new strategy to various conventional ones for evaluating and designing neuro-inspired architectures for effective signal processing. To improve flexibility, energy economy, and real-time capabilities, the suggested technique combines neuro-adaptive learning with sparsity-based optimization and real-time event-driven processing. The suggested method was compared to the more popular Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbors, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Neural Network, and Naive Bayes to see which one worked better. Two full tables show the results of looking at key performance factors such as accuracy, speed, energy economy, flexibility, CPU usage, memory consumption, and power consumption. It was found that the suggested method is better than the most recent ones in terms of accuracy, speed, and saving resources. It was found to be more flexible and works in real time, which makes it a good choice for users that need to handle signals quickly and accurately. Besides that, the suggested method uses fewer resources, such as fewer CPU cycles, memory, and power, compared to normal methods. These results show that signal processing designs that are based on neurons can be useful. These designs have a lot of potential to solve a wide range of real-world problems.

articleTitle: Fortifying Smart City IoT Networks: A Deep Learning-Based Attack Detection Framework with Optimized Feature Selection Using MGS-ROA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: With its rapid evolution, Internet of Things (IoT) technology has gone from connecting individual devices to enabling smart cities and widespread deployments in a wide range of businesses throughout the world. However, vulnerabilities and possible breaches in IoT networks emerge as a result of diverse devices employing different protocols and having limited processing capabilities. In this study, to use a deep learning procedure to examine the collected network traffic dataset in an Internet of Things setting and identify network assaults. The Google Colaboratory (Colab) environment is utilised to conduct this investigation utilising PySpark with Apache Spark. The research makes use of the Scikit-Learn and Keras libraries. In order to train besides evaluate the classical, the ‘CICIoT2023’ dataset is utilised. To make sure that important features are included in the testing, the datasets are reduced using the Modified Gear besides Steering-based Rider Optimization Algorithm (MGS-ROA). By utilizing the Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU), a deep learning algorithm is produced. There was a comparison between the created approach and algorithms that use machine learning and deep learning. F1 parameters, recall, accuracy, and precision were used to assess the representation’s presentation. The suggested ensemble method demonstrates outstanding performance in extensive experiments and comparisons, offering a strong answer to strengthen IoT networks.

Author Keywords: Modified Gear and Rider Optimization Algorithm

articleTitle: Modeling and Control Techniques for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles - A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Underwater applications are rapidly increasing as we explore underwater and marine environments due to their unique characteristics. Due to uncertainties, disturbances, dynamic characteristics, and constraints, the effective design of AUV models and control systems is always a challenging task. The designed AUV model and its controller need to be robust by adapting to the reference model to overcome the issues that arise in underwater environments. This article presents a detailed view and comprehensive comparison of recently published AUV control methods, strategies, and models. This article also provides the mathematical modeling behind AUV dynamics based on the system’s framework in a detailed manner. This review also discusses the open problems in AUV modeling and control systems while suggesting the design and development of more novel and innovative strategies for researchers.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Grading of Mango Quality Using External Characteristics: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Right now, a lot of subjective human judgment goes into classifying mangoes and other fruits, especially when it comes to poor productivity, which results in less than ideal classification accuracy. Our work suggests a novel method for assessing fruit quality that takes into account both weight and exterior features in order to address this. Mangoes are graded into three groups, G1, G2, and G3, using machine learning approaches, namely Support Vector Machine (SVM) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). These models make use of a variety of input features, transforming unstructured visual data into structured datasets for study. After preparation, the data are tested and trained to provide reliable classification results.

Author Keywords: Support Vector Machine (SVM) for fruit evaluation

articleTitle: Automated Wheat Leaf Disease Detection Using Deep Learning with TensorFlow and Keras
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Wheat leaf diseases seriously compromise world food security because of their impact on crop yields and quality. The quality and productivity of crops can be much affected by wheat leaf diseases. Good treatment of diseases depends on quick identification and accurate diagnosis. This work offers a creative approach employing TensorFlow and Keras, two powerful deep learning structures, for the evident proof of wheat leaf diseases. Convolutional neural network architecture was created to efficiently extract important features from photos of wheat leaves afflicted by different illnesses. To increase generalizability, the CNN model was taught on a collection of wheat leaf images using data augmentation methods. Images of wheat leaves stained with common illnesses including rust, blight, and mildew annotated on them train the system. The model’s efficient classification and analysis of the photos lets faster intervention and identification possible. Including transfer learning and data augmentation methods helps the model to be more generalizable. By means of automation of disease identification, this technology offers farmers and agricultural experts a scalable and efficient tool for enhancing crop health management. Thanks to its capacity to properly categorize wheat leaf diseases, as shown by the experimental findings, farmers and other agricultural experts seeking for quick diagnosis and treatment of diseases may find the suggested method to be a useful tool.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Detection and Prediction in Smart Grids Using Supervised Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy sources and distributed power generation in smart grids has significantly increased the complexity of fault detection and prediction. Traditional methods like Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Rule-Based Detection (RBD) face challenges in processing the vast amounts of real-time data generated by modern grids, often leading to delayed responses and low fault detection accuracy. Furthermore, conventional techniques such as Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) are rule-dependent and lack adaptability to dynamic grid conditions, resulting in inefficient fault prediction and grid stability issues. To overcome these challenges, this paper introduces an Intelligent Fault Detection and Prediction Model (IFDPM), utilizing supervised learning techniques to enhance the detection and prediction of faults in smart grids. The IFDPM leverages machine learning algorithms to process real-time grid data, improving both the accuracy and speed of fault identification. By continuously adapting to the grid’s operational environment, the proposed model predicts faults before they occur, enabling timely preventive actions. Through extensive simulations and testing, the IFDPM has demonstrated a 0.25% improvement in fault detection accuracy and a 0.20% reduction in response time compared to conventional methods. This approach provides a more reliable and efficient framework for managing fault events in next-generation smart grids.

Author Keywords: Intelligent Fault Detection and Prediction Model (IFDPM)

articleTitle: Sentinel AI: Revolutionizing Urban Security through Intelligent Video Surveillance in Indian Metropolises
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This project outlines the conceptualization and development of a cutting-edge Smart Security AI-driven Video Surveillance (SSAVS) system meticulously crafted to address the nuanced security challenges prevalent in bustling Indian metropolises. By amalgamating state-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) technologies with sophisticated video surveillance infrastructure, SSAVS aims to redefine the paradigm of urban security through proactive crime monitoring and prevention. By using cutting-edge machine learning techniques and real-time video analytics, SSAVS empowers law enforcement agencies with unparalleled capabilities to identify, analyze, and address security risks in urban environments swiftly. The system’s ability to identify suspicious activities, recognize potential threats, and predict anomalous behavior patterns facilitates preemptive intervention, thereby bolstering public safety and instilling confidence in urban communities. This paper elucidates the intricate architecture, functional intricacies, and implementation strategies of SSAVS, underlining its transformative potential in fortifying the security landscape of Indian metropolises and fostering safer, more resilient urban ecosystems.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Cloud Computing through Blockchain-based Resource Allocation and Green Contracts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The study that is being carried out is a blockchain resource allocation, green contract, and renewable energy integration into the cloud computing environments as a way to increase efficiency, sustainability, and stakeholders' satisfaction. Through empirical analysis, significant improvements were observed across various metrics: the resource usage rate is up to 90% from 75%, 20%-800 kWh/hour reduction in energy consumption, a 20% decrease in heat emissions to 400 kg CO2/hour, cost efficiency is improved by 20% to $ \$ $8 per hour. Moreover, the renewable energy usage was at 50%, which was followed by 50% fossil fuel dependency, in contrast, and a 100% carbon offset. Integrity was ensured with security threats eliminated, reporting and audit became much more transparent and together with the standards the compliance was achieved. Stakeholders such as Providers and End Users experienced enhanced success as the level of satisfaction was made the same for both cloud service providers and consumers This research result highlights the importance of the utilization of the blockchain enabled solutions in the optimization of resources, reducing the energy consumption, promoting the wide-range use of the renewable sources of the energy, enhancing the sector security and transparency therefore improving the satisfaction levels of all stakeholders in the cloud computing operation. The cooperation between scientists and various stakeholders has remained the key factor for implementing sustainable ways that will benefit the industry.

articleTitle: Advanced Feature Rich Medical Image Segmentation Based on Deep Feature Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Deep learning approaches have demonstrated significant potential in automating this activity, hence removing the necessity for radiologists to manually annotate images. Concatenate blocks are incorporated in the suggested model in order to learn various filters or features that are utilised to extract relevant information from the image. Since k-fold validation is a strong and adaptable method for assessing deep learning model performance, it is used to train the suggested model. By setting the value of k to 5, the suggested model is tested on five distinct data subsets in order to produce the optimised model and produce more accurate results. Ten percent was used for validation, twenty percent for testing, and seventy percent for training. The suggested model was built in four stages: (a) picture classification, (b) feature attribute selection, (c) tumour segmentation, and (d) noise removal. We suggest using deep neural networks, trained on MRI scans of patients’ brains, to detect tumours. For tumour segmentation, the suggested architectures rely on inception modules and convolutional neural networks.

articleTitle: Implementing Multi-factor Authentication in Cloud Services for Enhanced Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The cloud services which are now the most common data transmission and endanger organizations’ confidential information, it’s more and more visible that security of any data should be a main priority for companies. MFA, which consists of adopting multi factor approach to authentication and thereby provides multiple types of verification thus ensures effective security, is leveraged to ensure resource access. This paper proposes a full-fledged way of implementing MFA for cloud services in order to strengthen the security given and manage the constatoing risks. The proposed methodology consists of main stages like requirements determining, technology reviewing, risks assessment, technology design, integration with cloud services, users training, pilot deployment and testing, implementation and configuration, monitoring and maintenance as well as constant improvement. Through a systemic approach, the organizations can be equipped with the capability to personalize the MFA solutions according to their security goals, to bring the cloud environments on board, as well as to ensure that the organizations comply with the security standards as set by various governing bodies. This research adds a grain of salt to the development of cloud security good practices through offering a disciplined approach to MFA implementation, which allows partners to harden their cloud assets and protect against growing cyber threats.

articleTitle: Optimizing User Data Privacy and Confidentiality in Cloud Storage Systems Through Advanced Obfuscrypt Encryption Methods for Enhanced Security and Efficient Data Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: With a steady increase in the adoption of cloud storage systems, the client’s data are at risk of being leaked. There are several methods of encrypting data which are quite useful but they lack some of the features of today’s sophisticated threats. The methodology used in this research propose an encryption framework known as Obfuscrypt to improve the issues of data privacy as well as confidentiality of data stored in cloud storage systems. Obfuscrypt uses conventional encryption strategies incorporated with obfuscation and post-quantum cryptographic algorithms to provide a complex security plan immune to classic and quantum approaches. Some of the proposed other innovations include the decentralised key management with multi-factor authentication and RBAC-ABE as the fine-grained access control techniques. These features make it possible for only the authorized personnel to be in a position to be in a position of decrypting and retrieving the stored data thereby minimizing the possibility of the data being accessed by unauthorized people. The work also considers the issue of performance efficiency of the cloud storage systems. Similar to other symmetric encryption programs, Obfuscrypt uses light encryption algorithms and brings in to play the hardware acceleration so that it may infuse lesser computational overhead in the process of encryption and decryption. As can be clearly seen from the results, the actual work proves that the proposed framework not only offers a higher level of security but does not affect the system performance to a great extent. Also, the study addresses the post-quantum cryptographic algorithm for making the system resistant to an attack that can be posed by quantum computing systems. With the help of these improved algorithms, Obfuscrypt guarantees the permanent data security in the world of constantly emerging cyber threats.

articleTitle: Securing Multi-Tenant Cloud Environments with Fully Homomorphically Encrypted Secure Multiparty Computation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The aim of this work is to examine the application of FHE-SMPC as a viable security model for protecting the tenant isolation in multi-tenant cloud model. In multi-tenant environments, where various customers use the same cloud system, controlling the data leakage and protecting privacy is a major issue. Actual safeguards fail to meet the needs of data protection during processing, therefore, the introduction of highly elaborate encryption processes must happen. This research work focuses on the use of FHE technique and SMPC such that data can undergo processing while the plaintext remains unknown to any party. A kind of approach is based on the acquisition of synthetic and real data sets, system-level architecture, and cryptographic algorithms using open-source libraries with cloud service providers. The results of such implementation indicate that despite the fact that the FHE-SMPC system has a considerable computational overhead in comparison with classical schemes it is very secure and protected against different types of cryptographic attacks. The problem of scalability is still an open issue, but the complex is quite efficient with various data types that is why it can be used in various cloud applications. This paper offers a pertinent solution for security of data that is housed in multitenant environment and will go along way in creating fertile ground for research and innovation in secure clouding.

articleTitle: Secured Homomorphic Encryption and Authentication for Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Secure communication and data processing is one of the vital requirements for applications like healthcare, feedback systems, voting etc. In the traditional cryptographic algorithms, the data is to be decrypted before processing. When the processing is carried at a third party, the privacy is compromised. Thus, such applications require a system where the data processing is done without actually knowing the data. Homomorphic Encryption (HE) is one such solution to this problem where, the encrypted data is processed at the third-party level without performing decryption. It provides secured data communication between sender(s) and receiver by preserving privacy. It not only assures privacy but also avoids multiple decryption operations to perform data processing. Nevertheless, one of the challenges in this system is to guarantee the authenticity of the data requester. This can be accomplished using authentication protocols over HE. This paper proposes an Authentication Protocol over a Partial Homomorphic Encryption (PHE) system for healthcare data. The patient data is processed at cloud in encryption domain and the results are sent to the data requester on proving one’s authenticity. This ensures both privacy of the information and authenticity of the data requester.

articleTitle: Tomato Leaf Disease Detection Using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Plant diseases cause low agricultural productivity. Plant diseases are challenging for the majority of farmers to control and identify. To reduce future losses, early disease diagnosis is necessary. This study presents a deep learning approach for detecting tomato leaf diseases using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The proposed method involves preprocessing the tomato leaf images, followed by training the CNN model to classify them into one of ten categories: healthy, yellow leaf curl virus (YLCV), bacterial spot (BS), early blight (EB), leaf mold (LM), spectoria leaf spot (SLS), target spot (TS), two spotted spider mite spot(TSSMS), mosaic virus(MV) and late blight (LB). The data sets are collected from Kaggle. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in detecting tomato leaf diseases. The automated approach can aid in the early detection and prevention of tomato diseases, which can ultimately help in improving the yield and quality of tomato crops.

articleTitle: Brain tumor detection using with GW Deep CNN LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Brain tumors are recognized as severe illnesses wherein the precision of images plays a crucial role. Accurately identifying tumors is essential for precisely pinpointing the affected area and thereby reducing the mortality rate. Consequently, understanding the hidden patterns becomes imperative for an improved diagnosis and image quality. However, achieving accurate diagnoses across various lesion cases poses a significant challenge. To address the limitations of existing methods, To be able to automatically detect brain cancers from MRI scans, we introduce a hybrid architecture dubbed Deep Convolutional Neural Network with LSTM (Deep CNN&LSTM) that makes utilizes a Gaussian filter. There are several layers in the Deep CNN&LSTM approach, and each one is essential to the processing pipeline. Brain MRI pictures are first obtained from a certain database. In order to improve the clarity and quality of the images, a Gaussian weighted nonlocal mean filter is used during the preprocessing stage to eliminate noisy pixels. After preprocessing, the image is segmented using U net segmentation approach, which divide the picture into areas with comparable features isolating areas of interest, such as possible tumor locations, requires this procedure. An LSTM network is then fed the retrieved features to classify the data. Because of the capabilities of the LSTM, it is possible to analyze the sequential nature of the extracted features and accurately determine if the input image is normal or contains a tumor. The Deep CNN-LSTM architecture is exceptional in detecting diseases with high accuracy while reducing processing time and error rate. Because of its effectiveness, it holds great promise for the automatic identification of brain tumors, facilitating quicker and more accurate clinical judgment.

articleTitle: Refining Heart Disease Diagnosis with Machine Learning: Techniques for Optimal Medical Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Studying disease in healthcare, diagnosis occurs. Diseases are diseases that cause pain, illness, or death. Everyone deserves optimal health, according to the WHO. Healthcare professionals should do regular health exams. Globally, heart disease kills ${3 1 \%}$ of people.
