articleTitle: Automated Land Cover Classification in Urban Environments with Deep Learning-Based Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Partisan symbolism has become a vital asset for various applications, including land cover classification, urban planning, disaster management, and environmental monitoring. In this study, a deep learning approach is proposed for the semantic segmentation of satellite images. The proposed model leverages a multi-level U-Net architecture, which has shown effectiveness in various image segmentation tasks. The dataset used in this study comprises satellite images with corresponding ground truth masks labeling different land cover classes, such as buildings, roads, vegetation, water bodies, and unlabeled regions. The data is preprocessed, and the ground truth masks are encoded into categorical labels to facilitate model training. The model is trained using a combination of pixel-wise crossentropy loss and the Jaccard coefficient as evaluation metrics to optimize performance. Test results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in accurately segmenting satellite images, achieving high accuracy and Jaccard coefficient values on both training and validation datasets. Additionally, a comprehensive analysis of the model’s performance is provided, discussing potential applications and future directions for satellite image segmentation tasks. The trained model is saved for further deployment and integration into satellite image processing pipelines, offering valuable insights for various remote sensing applications.

articleTitle: Optimized Constrained Application Protocol for IoT Smart Home Data Security: A Novel Lightweight Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: By increasing simplicity and efficiency, a smart environment aims to enhance human existence. The IoT paradigm has evolved into a crucial technology for creating smart buildings, and the majority of computer networks now have IoT technologies. Nevertheless, during this shift, IoT devices are susceptible to cyberattacks. Thus, in practical smart home applications, security and privacy are key issues. In order to improve data security in smart home settings while lowering computing costs, this publication proposes the Broken-Stick Regressive Lightweight Speck Ephemeral Cryptography-based Constrained Application Protocol (BRLSC-CoAP). Real-time data is gathered by IoT devices and sent to authorized users. BRLSC-CoAP includes processes for authentication, encryption, decryption, and registration to safeguard this process. Forbes indexive Broken-stick regression is used to verify user authentication, and a lightweight Speck ephemeral cryptography technique is utilized for encryption. The experimental findings demonstrate that BRLSC-CoAP performs better than traditional techniques by increasing confidentiality, accuracy, and precision in authentication while lowering computing overhead, delay, and cost..

articleTitle: Advanced Hybrid Techniques for Early Diagnosis of Mammogram Images: Combining Deep and Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Digital image processing is a nascent field that emerged alongside computers. Its techniques vary by job. Applications that save, compress, distribute, and visualize images are different from those that analyze images for human visual perception. Digital image processing helps doctors diagnose patients using visual data in hospitals and clinics. In CAD systems, mammography-based early breast cancer detection is significant. CAD systems make unhealthy tissues more evident in medical images like digital chest X -rays and mammograms to facilitate early identification. Some clinicians prescribe digital mammography scans for women over 40 without a history of breast cancer. CAD systems employ low-dose X-rays that are mild on healthy breast tissue but conceal healthy and ill cells, making diagnosis harder. Thus, mammography second opinions are frequently needed to support and enhance medical decisions. Recent advances in deep and machine learning, particularly with computer-aided diagnostic tools, have improved diagnosis accuracy. Compared to prior methods, deep convolutional layers yield more resilient and recognizable features. Breast tumors are identified and classified using AlexNet and ResNet-18 models trained with AdaBoost. Mammograms are enhanced using an average filter first. Deep convolutional layers extract the most reliable deep characteristics. The AdaBoost technique classifies these traits, showing how deep learning and machine learning may improve diagnostic accuracy. The combination of ResnetNet-18 and Adaboost was the most effective hybrid model out of all the ones that were evaluated. The test results showed an accurateness of $\mathbf{8 1 . 5 \%}$, a compassion of $\mathbf{9 2 \%}$, and a specificity of $\mathbf{7 0 . 5 \%}$. The conclusions demonstration that using ResNet in conjunction with AdaBoost, a deep learning framework, improves diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Technique for early Parkinson’s Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease is a neurological ailment that affects millions of people globally and has serious health consequences. Neuro degenerative illnesses, notably Parkinson’s disease, presents substantial hurdles in clinical practice needs early detection. In this study, a thorough description of a new approach for Parkinson’s detection using Support Vector Machines (SVM) in the Google Colab computing environment is presented. The Programme developed tackles the important for PD early identification and treatment. The aim of this project is to create a sophisticated ML model that can identify Parkinson’s disease with accuracy by utilizing a variety of pertinent parameters. The basis of this study is a meticulously selected dataset from Kaggle. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed SVM-based approach in improving the early diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease, highlighting its practical application in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Fault Handling and Resource Management Strategies for FOG Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: An exciting new development, fog computing makes use of existing cloud infrastructure to fulfil service demands from edge devices connected to IoT. Due to highly dynamic and diverse nature of infrastructure situated at the periphery of the web, breakdowns are common occurrences, making fault tolerance an essential need. Prior iterations of scheduling and fault-tolerant algorithms paid little attention to requests with a tight deadline. Unfavourable consequences, such as longer wait times for certain requests, are more likely as a result. This work presents a FTSM for distributing service gadget queries in fog cloud Connectivity settings that are well equipped to handle them. Reducing service overhead and latency while increasing cloud stability and capacity is the primary goal of the suggested solution. Sorting request-making devices into one of three groups based on the service type is important to the approach. You may categorise these classes as core, time-sensitive, and time-tolerant. Every time an application is timed-sensitive, it is immediately mapped to any number of edge gadgets using an executive directory of equipment that has already been generated. Any cloud-based device, whether it’s at the network’s periphery or its heart, can handle time-sensitive demands. Applications for services in the cloud’s foundation are handled there. Achieving a maximum availability of ${9 5 \%}$, the suggested technique FTSM consistently outperforms the other methods, CKM and RM, across numerous circumstances. While CKM and RM maintain lower availability percentages, FTSM proves to be the most dependable strategy when considering availability. This ongoing benefit demonstrates how much better the suggested approach is than the alternatives.

articleTitle: Enhancing Fraud Detection with Deep Learning: A Robust Automated Counterfeit System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Counterfeit currency is a serious hazard to individuals, financial institutions, and enterprises in the current global economy. Maintaining the integrity of financial transactions and protecting against potential losses require the correct identification of counterfeit banknotes. Using machine learning, and pattern recognition approaches, significant progress has been made in developing automated counterfeit detection systems. In order to protect transaction security and the public’s faith in their currency, these technologies are designed to precisely recognise and differentiate real banknotes from counterfeit ones. The application examines banknote security features like microprinting, security thread, holograms, and watermarks using sophisticated image recognition and machine learning techniques. Additionally, it uses a variety of verification techniques, such as infrared (IR) scanning, magnetic ink detection, and ultraviolet (UV) light detection, to confirm the legitimacy of currency. By using to Brute Force Matching and K-Nearest Neighbour algorithms photos of currency are classified as real or fake

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Legal Case Analysis through Advanced Event Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In India manually evaluating court records was time-consuming and prone to errors, leading to delays in justice administration. Legal Sarathi, an automated event extraction tool was proposed to address this issue, it utilized Large Language Models coupled with other cutting-edge Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. Legal Sarathi analyzes unstructured legal case documents to extract time frames, significant participants and major events to improve speed and accuracy. It featured state-of-the-art Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities for prompt and precise case analysis whose aims included speeding up the analysis of court proceedings and real-time information retrieval, while simultaneously providing critical data for informed decision-making. The tools deliverables comprised an automated event extraction system, a highly preprocessed data corpus, a sophisticated NLP model, a user-friendly interface and thorough validation results. Ultimately, this established an improved and equitable legal system in India to ensure that all parties received quick and fair access to the courts and fostered public trust.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare Data Security in Cloud Computing Systems through Advanced Homomorphic Encryption Techniques Integrated with Cuckoo Search Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The studies in this research are focused on the mix of homomorphic encryption mechanisms and the Cuckoo Search Optimization Algorithm to promote the security of the healthcare data in the cloud computing system. I have observed that cloud solutions are now at the center of the contemporary health care systems, and security of patient’s data remains a top priority. Earlier used encryption techniques, though secure if implemented, have problems in the way that data is to be processed first it has to be decrypted and then made ready for use - it is in this phase that data can be easily hacked into. Homomorphic encryption provides solution to this issue since it enables one to perform computations on encrypted data while maintaining its confidentiality. However, it takes a lot of computation which presents a lot of problems even in terms of simple performance. The Cuckoo Search Algorithm, a new nature-inspired metaheuristic, is incorporated into the encryption process to provide further optimization, whilst preserving the security benefits of the algorithm. The use of the proposed methodology takes place employing Python and its deployment at the cloud platform with elaborated dataset containing anonymized records extracted from electronic health records. The outcome proves that there are great enhancements in encryption and decryption time, computational complexity, and capacity, and thereby making the system appropriate for real-world healthcare solutions. This research offers a strong base for protection of healthcare data in cloud and is useful for the enhancement of adaptive, comprehensive and secure cloud computing systems.

articleTitle: Effective IOT Attack Detection with Optimal Feature Selection and Random Forest: Performance Enhancement using Spider Monkey Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: IoT is a combination of software and hardware that collects and shares data, using networks, sensors, and electronics. IP addresses allow devices to communicate with one other over the internet and exchange data inside the network. The IoT idea is crucial for creating smart surroundings, such as smart cities and houses, applicable to many sectors. Smart environments address living environment, industrial demands, and energy consumption, promoting creativity and competitiveness in everyday life. The growing prominence of IoT applications and services across networks highlights the primary objective. The first paper introduces the SMO-RF technique to detect IoT device threats. Use this optimization strategy to choose attributes related to restrictions. The SMO method combines optimal characteristics for RF categorization during selection. As per the 80-20 rule, features undergo initial classification before being classified in the RF. When applying higher feature values to RF models, the best fitness values are considered. SMO minimizes overfitting by using information to categorization. AUC, recall, F-Measure, accuracy, and precision are used to assess the performance of this approach. NSL-KDD is freely accessible and used with SMO-RF. The SMO-RF approach identifies Probe, U2R, R2L, and DoS attacks more accurately than current IoT solutions.

articleTitle: Improving Crop Yields and Resource Efficiency in Organic Farming Using Advanced Optimization Techniques: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The use of optimization techniques in modern agriculture is growing, and these methods frequently introduce dangerous substances into the food chain, posing serious health hazards. In an effort to fulfill the rising demand for food, non-organic agricultural techniques are displacing traditional systems, which rely on farmers’ expertise and natural practices. But these actions have a negative impact on the environment and human health. This effort intends to address these concerns by developing a prediction model to improve agricultural processes and boost the production of organic food. The model uses statistical models and machine learning algorithms to estimate ideal crop development circumstances, including humidity, rainfall, and soil demands. This helps farmers overcome challenges such as unforeseen weather and crop diseases. To guarantee precise forecasts and sustainable agricultural methods, the technique entails methodical data gathering, preprocessing, model training, testing, and fine-tuning. The results show that applying these optimization techniques may result in a 15% increase in crop output, a 20% reduction in water consumption, and a 10% reduction in fertilizer use. These improvements assist farmers in improving health outcomes, reducing their negative effects on the environment, and boosting their revenue. The study shows how advanced analytics might transform agriculture, support data-driven decision-making, and aid in providing food for a growing global population in a sustainable manner.

articleTitle: Unraveling the Potential of 6G Wireless Communication Systems in Next-Generation Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The entrance of 6G wireless communication systems has reached the peak of connectivity development as the systems are projected to stand out with the remarkable speed, reliability and efficiency level not only compared to previous versions but also on the global level. This article will disclose the 6G transforming of industries, bringing the economical growth and facing the societal challenges. Attaining the achievements of data rates, latency, and reliability via modern technologies like terahertz waves and massive MIMO systems that 6G networks sovereigns, the latter offers progressive implementations across different domains. The applications of 6G technology go beyond the reality to remote surgery using real-time machines and automated smart factories, to communication of autonomous vehicles and immersive experiences, the new concept of human-machine interaction with the new 6G technology is nothing but a hope of an innovative future. Secondly, 6G brings a new era of growth and will lead to an inclusive society with a lower level of economic inequality. Through job provision, wealth enhancement, and reduction in greenhouse gases, 6G networks can catalyze fairness and empower those who were neglected previously. While there are various possibilities of 6G especially privacy breaches, cyber-attacks, and network vulnerabilities, the technology may be also the source of these risks or challenges. This is justified by the active preparation of risk management and strong security measures and the assurance of 6G networks against violation.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition of South Indian Regional Languages in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, which focuses on understanding people’s feelings, has become more popular recently. The main challenges in sentiment analysis include gathering large amounts of data, using the right methods or algorithms, and sorting it into different categories based on emotions. With the internet growing rapidly, social media has become a popular platform for people to share their feelings. Sentiment analysis using Twitter data, emphasizing the need for a comprehensive approach to understanding user sentiments. Leveraging Twitter APIs, gather tweets and employ TextBlob for sentiment scoring, classifying sentiments as positive, negative, or neutral. In a departure from conventional methods, this model incorporates emojis and images, broadening the scope of sentiment interpretation. It even determine sentiment scoring based on different slangs of different languages. Moreover, this paper shift focus from isolated words to analyzing the emotional context of entire sentences, enhancing the accuracy of sentiment classification.

articleTitle: Accuracy Improvement in Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy, a prevalent side effect of diabetes, can cause severe vision impairment if it is not detected early. It can cause a lot of harm to life as vision happens to be a very important human sense.By incorporating machine learning algorithms into traditional methods of diagnosis, healthcare providers can greatly increase the prediction accuracy and efficiency of detecting diabetic retinopathy. There are many key advantages of machine learning algorithms, a primary advantage is their ability to be able to analyze a vast amount of data very quickly and highly accurately. This can then help us identify those patterns and trends that may not be immediately apparent to the human eye. In the case of diabetic retinopathy, these algorithms can analyze retinal images to detect early signs of the condition, allowing for earlier intervention and better patient outcomes. In addition, machine learning algorithms can also help reduce the subjectivity and variability that can be present in manual examinations by ophthalmologists. By providing consistent and standardized results, machine learning can improve the reliability of diagnostic assessments, which then leads to more precise and a more effective treatment plan for patients. Moreover, the integration of machine learning algorithms into healthcare systems can help address challenges such as limited resources and access to specialized care. By automating the screening process for diabetic retinopathy, healthcare providers can prioritize high-risk patients for further evaluation and treatment, this ensures that resources are being allocated efficiently and that patients receive their timely care. Overall, the research presented in this paper highlights the potential of machine learning algorithms that can revolutionize the diagnosis and management of diabetic retinopathy. By combining the strengths of technology with the expertise of healthcare professionals, it is possible to improve patient diagnosis, reduce the healthcare costs, and ultimately, save vision.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Improving Near-Field Automotive Radar Sensing and Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In this research, we investigate how deep learning techniques may be used to improve the sensing and imaging capabilities of near-field car radar. High precision, real-time processing, and flexibility to different environmental conditions are essential for near-field radar sensing to be used in autonomous driving and advanced driver-assistance systems. In this study, we suggest a technique that uses deep learning to analyze radar data more effectively. Here, we describe three fundamental algorithms: one for preprocessing radar data, another for object recognition using the Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD), and a third for super-resolving radar images. Noise is removed and normalization is performed on the radar data in the preprocessing step to prepare it for deep learning. Real-time object recognition is handled by an SSD, while radar picture super-resolution is handled by a deep convolutional neural network. Metrics like as detection accuracy, false positive rate, false negative rate, precision, recall, F1 score, and inference speed are used to evaluate performance. The accuracy and processing time of the proposed approach are compared to those of six established methods: RANSAC, Hough Transform, SIFT, SURF, ORB, and FAST. The experiments show that the suggested approach is more precise than the state-of-the-art methods. The suggested technique also has a processing time benefit, making it suitable for real-time applications. Positive outcomes have been seen when deep learning methods were applied to vehicle radar for sensing and imaging in the near-field. To meet the stringent criteria of autonomous driving systems, the suggested technique considerably improves accuracy while keeping efficiency high. This study adds to the continued development of safer and more economical autonomous cars, delivering a viable solution for near-field radar perception.

articleTitle: Transforming Education with Innovative Virtual Learning Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: There are several issues with traditional schooling, including poor student participation, rigid scheduling, and restricted accessibility. We require a cutting-edge virtual classroom management system that uses technology to create a dynamic and engaging learning environment in order to solve these problems. The Innovative Virtual Learning Environments is a modern web-based application developed using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). It offers a dynamic virtual learning environment, bridging the gap between traditional and remote education by providing features like live video lectures, chat messaging, assignment submissions. By enabling remote attendance, the system removes geographical constraints, enhances accessibility, and offers flexibility and convenience to educators and students. It aims to lower education costs, making high-quality education more affordable and accessible. Utilizing modern web development tools and real-time communication protocols like WebSocket’s or WebRTC, the system ensures a interactive and engaging learning experience, promoting teamwork, personalized learning, and real-time communication. The objective is to foster an environment of active learning and continuous interaction, so equipping our users with the critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills necessary to thrive in an increasingly digital and interconnected world.

articleTitle: A New Era in Fishing Safety: RF and GSM Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Fishermen operating in international waters often confront significant challenges, including unintentional breaches of foreign maritime boundaries, sudden weather changes, and the lack of prompt emergency assistance. These issues can lead to detainment, threaten livelihoods, and pose serious safety risks. To address these challenges, we have developed an advanced system that employs Radio Frequency (RF) technology for accurate maritime boundary detection, along with GSM-based communication for real-time distress signaling. The system provides timely alerts to fishermen as they near international borders, thereby minimizing the risk of accidental trespassing. In emergencies, it automatically transmits an SOS signal with precise location information to base stations and nearby vessels, ensuring a rapid and coordinated response. Additionally, the system’s real-time weather monitoring capabilities enhance navigational decision-making, contributing to safer journeys. By integrating border detection, distress signaling, and weather monitoring, the system not only boosts operational efficiency and ensures compliance with maritime regulations “but also optimizes resource management and route planning. Through the combined use of satellite and RF technologies, it enables precise navigation, effective collision avoidance, and efficient route optimization. This comprehensive approach represents a significant advancement in maritime safety, providing fishermen with the essential tools for secure and sustainable navigation while protecting both their livelihoods and the marine environment.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Investigation on Features Selection using Statistical Tests for EMG Signal Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Gesture recognition is vital in applications such as bionic arms, robotics, virtual reality etc., development and deployments. EMG signals have gained traction for recognizing hand and finger gestures. This study focuses on investigating prominent features using statistical approaches. To achieve this a standard EMG dataset is made use off, comprising 36 participants with 8 unique hand gestures. The EMG signals were processed through three main stages: Firstly, feature extraction: temporal, frequency domain, logarithmic determinants, and logarithmic Teager-Kaiser Energy Operator (TKEO) features are extracted from the first-channel data, resulting in 40 feature dimension. Second, feature selection: statistical tests such as Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) and Kruskal-Wallis(KW) are employed to identify the most significant features and are ranked. Visualization of the significant and non-significant features reveals separability of each class. Classification is subsequently performed using Random Forest (RF) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithms. Results demonstrate that the feature set combinations ranked by ANOVA, {LogTKEO} and {LogTKEO, Willison Amplitude} with RF classifier exhibits 0.85 and 0.86 accuracy respectively. However, features ranked by both ANOVA and KW have surpassed the accuracies in literature by 0.02 using single channel data.

articleTitle: An Interaction Paradigm to Facilitate Cardiac and Nerve Anatomy using Augmented and Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This work describes a design methodology for developing an interactive visualization environment using Augmented Reality (AR) based on Head Mounted Displays (HMDs) to provide a learning experience for cardiac and Nerve anatomy. After precise model geometry was obtained by computed tomography imaging techniques and optimized in a 3D modeling software package, photo-realistic texture mapping was achieved by using 3D painting software. Using this strategy makes modeling intricate, organic geometry easier. The Unity game engine was used to provide animation, rendering methods, and augmented reality functionality. The architecture and development of the system depicts complicated learning information, maximizes immersion, and facilitates natural gesture interaction inside a real-world learning environment. An accessible way to illustrate cross-section rendering in augmented reality was achieved by combining hand input with a surgical dissection metaphor. This technique has led to well-directed lessons being learned.

articleTitle: Optimizing Energy Efficiency in Wireless Body Area Networks through NEEMA: A Hybrid Meta-Heuristic Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Recent developments in Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) technology have created a wide range of sensors capable of monitoring various physiological parameters in patients. However, the limited battery life of these sensors has constrained the potential of WBAN, highlighting the need for energy-efficient algorithms to address their substantial energy demands. To address this challenge, this paper introduces a novel Energy Efficient Hybrid Meta-Heuristic Approach (NEEMA) for WBANs. NEEMA combines the Tunicate Swarm Algorithm (TSA) and Genetic Algorithm (GA), collectively known as T-GA, to achieve high convergence and broad exploitation and exploration capabilities. The approach incorporates a clustering methodology to determine the Cluster Head (CH) using a fitness function derived from T-GA, which considers innovative parameters for conserving energy across the network. The study underscores the importance of multi-hop communication between patients equipped with sensor nodes, enabling data transmission to healthcare providers through multiple Relay Head (RH) nodes, transmitting data to subsequent RHs and ultimately to the central data sink. The process for selecting RHs mirrors that of CHs. Experimental results demonstrate that NEEMA outperforms existing algorithms and offers advantages for various WBAN applications.

articleTitle: AI Enabled Home Security System Using Object Detection and Face Recognition with Haar Cascade Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In this paper smart lock and alert system is implemented using Haar Cascade algorithm. Both face detection and recognition are done by using Haar Cascade algorithm. To share the information with the owner of the house or concerned people, internet of thing (IoT) is incorporated. For all these things to implement effectively, the operating system (OS) based system on chip(SoC) that is Raspberry Pi 4 running Haar Cascade algorithm for face detection and recognition is utilized to constitute edge computing. In this system when the known face is detected, the algorithm gets activated in such a way that door will get unlocked. Additionally, when the unknown face is detected, the algorithm activates, and mail will be sent with an unknown photo as attachment to the authorized person. This enables the owner to take proper action as soon as possible before any danger happens. The algorithm is implementation using python script on Raspberry Pi 4 connected with camera to capture the face at the door area. The key findings from the implementation are accuracy, response time and reliability of model. The algorithm along with a well-maintained database accurately identifies individuals and distinguishes between known and unknown faces. The efficient processing capabilities of Raspberry Pi swift response time since its edge computing rather than cloud computing. The system consistently performs well under different lighting and environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Advanced Meta-Learning Techniques for Inference of Neural States Under Anesthetic Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In order to improve our understanding of brain systems, monitoring the depth of unconsciousness during anesthesia is essential in clinical settings and neuroscience research. EEG data offers a dependable way to characterize changed brain arousal and cognitive states brought on by anesthetics in real time. Analyzing these alterations is difficult since different general anesthetics affect cerebral electrical activity in different ways. Because EEG data has a naturally low Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), traditional machine learning models have had trouble processing it, especially when it comes to office-based anesthesia. Deep learning models have been widely used in Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) activities including pattern recognition and classification because of their strong generalization and noise-handling skills. Deep learning has not been extensively studied in the context of classifying brain states during anesthesia, despite its success in other BCI applications. This work presents a unique framework for classifying brain states under anesthesia that combines deep neural networks and meta-learning. The suggested technique combines the use of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to model temporal dependencies, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for extracting power spectrum features, and a meta-learning strategy to handle the significant variability among patients.

articleTitle: Advanced Multi-Spectral Image Processing Techniques for Enhanced Remote Sensing and Comprehensive Environmental Monitoring in Diverse Ecosystems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The research is aimed at improvement of multi-spectral image analysis for remote sensing and monitoring the environment at various ecosystems. A combined spectral imagery encompasses several spectrums at a time compared to single spectral imagery that takes only one spectrum at an instance or at a given area to cover all these spectrums. The study employs digital high resolution satellite images and ground based data to quantify the vegetation vigour, water quality, soil characteristics and changes in land cover. Features, indexes, and classification routines are employed to process the data that is collected with the aid of avionics and other peripherals. This provincial level modelling highlights important gains in environmental status, which includes the general improvement in vegetation condition, water quality as well as physical properties of the soil in the province. This study focuses on the complementary possibilities of integration of multi-spectral imaging with other remote sensing technologies and the high performance of data processing. These techniques play significant roles if used to give current and comprehensive information in the management and conservation of the environment as highlighted in the study.

articleTitle: Multimedia Data Transmission in Underwater Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) have come a long way, mostly due to the growing need for reliable underwater communication systems. The goal of this project is to leverage Light Fidelity (Li-Fi) technology to build and implement a multimedia data transfer system inside an underwater wireless sensor network (UWSN). The project makes use of Li-Fi’s high bandwidth and low latency to overcome the shortcomings of currently available acousticbased underwater communication systems. Real-time multimedia data transfer in underwater environments is made possible by the system’s design and execution, which have applications ranging from environmental monitoring to subsea exploration and defence. Utilizing Li-Fi in UWSNs offers a fresh method of getting over the drawbacks of traditional radiofrequency and acoustic-based communication methods. Because visible light is difficult to stray from its intended transmission channel, the system may achieve better data speeds, lower latency, and more security by using it. This research work shows that deploying Li-Fi in UWSNs for dependable, fast multimedia communication is feasible and has benefits. According to the research, Li-Fi has the potential to completely transform underwater communication and provide the groundwork for next advancements in real-time monitoring, subsea data transfer, and exploration technology.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Areca Nut Yellow Leaf Disease with ResNet-50 CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Detecting healthy arecanut leaves, yellow leaf disease in arecanut, and differentiating these from other types of leaves using deep learning involves designing an advanced neural network model for precise image classification. The model is trained on a dataset comprising images of healthy arecanut leaves, arecanut leaves affected by yellow leaf disease, and various other leaves from different plant species. Convolution Neural Networks (CNNs) are leveraged to extract and analyze intricate patterns in the images, enabling the model to effectively classify each leaf type. Transfer learning techniques might be utilized to improve the model’s performance and adaptability. The model’s effectiveness is evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score on a dedicated test dataset. This paper explores the methodology and results of employing image detection for the identification of healthy arecanut leaves, yellow leaf disease, and other leaf types, with potential applications in agricultural diagnostics, disease management, and crop monitoring.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cheque Security: Forgery Detection Via Signature Recognition Using Optical Character Recognition and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Trustworthy verification of bank checks is crucial for modern financial transaction security and the prevention of fraudulent activities. A novel approach to the authentication and categorization of bank check signatures is introduced in this study. It employs a comprehensive architecture that integrates CNN, line sweep algorithms, and optical character recognition (OCR). The proposed method aims to improve the accuracy and efficacy of signature verification processes by harnessing the potential of state-of-the-art technology. First, the system uses optical character recognition to extract text from images of checks; this allows it to recognize crucial components including account data and text-based attributes. The line sweep method to spatial connections within images of checks also helps to emphasize key features like account numbers and signatures. The technique relies heavily on Convolutional Neural Networks. The system is able to differentiate between authentic and false samples based on their distinct patterns and characteristics by training convolutional neural networks (CNNs) using a big collection of signatures. With this wealth of information at its disposal, the system can confidently assess the signatures’ authenticity, resulting in a more robust and accurate verification procedure. Next, they came up with an innovative way to identify signatures and validate bank checks using convolutional neural networks (CNNs), optical character recognition (OCR), and line sweep analysis. With the automation and improvement of verification procedures, monetary transactions will be more trustworthy, less prone to errors, and more secure.

articleTitle: Predicting Blood Pressure from Photoplethysmogram Data: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The prediction of BP from photoplethysmogram (PPG) data using machine learning has garnered significant interest. However, discrepancies in dataset size, subject numbers, and pre-processing methods across studies hinder fair performance comparisons and obscure the generalization capabilities of BP estimation models. To address this, the largest dataset available for benchmarking BP estimation models “PulseDB”, was introduced, and designed to meet standardised testing protocols. PulseDB is sourced from both the VitaIDB database and the MIMIC-III waveform database. It also provides subjects' identification and demographic information for enhanced model performance and generalizability assessment, also PPG signal characteristic points for minimal pre-processing in deep learning models. Using PulseDB, this study is the first to investigate the performance gap between calibration-based method & the calibration-free testing methods regarding the generalizing ability of blood pressure estimation models. The PulseDB database aims to serve as reliable, user friendly, and comprehensive data for evaluating BP estimation methods. This study presents a blood pressure measuring system using photoplethysmograph signals and machine learning (ML) models and identifies optimal regression models for independent estimation of the SBP and the DBP. This model yielded significant outcomes, achieving the RMSE of 8.7955 for SBP and 5.3977 for DBP, highlighting its superior performance in BP estimation.

articleTitle: Enhanced 5-Channel DWDM Demux Using Photonic Crystal Hexagonal Ring Resonators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This study presents the design and analysis of a 5-channel dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) demultiplexer based on a photonic crystal (PC) hexagonal ring resonator (HRR). By varying the radius of a unique hole inside each HRR, the novel method enables exact wavelength control. The apparatus is ideal for applications using Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifiers (EDFAs) and operates in the wavelength range of 1535 to 1539 nm. With a maximum channel crosstalk of $\mathbf{- 1 5 . 3 9} \mathbf{~ d B}$ and an average channel coupling efficiency of $\mathbf{7 2 . 4 \%}$, the study shows good signal separation performance. The Plane-Wave Expansion (PWE) approach is used to determine the device's photonic band gap (PBG), and the Finite-Difference time domain (FDTD) method is used to analyze the electromagnetic (EM) field. This research contributes to the advancement of integrated optical components, showcasing the potential of PC-based devices in enhancing the capacity and efficiency of optical communication systems.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Enhanced Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy Using a Modified Fast RCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: In the present work a deep learning model for the detection of diabetic retinopathy has been proposed using faster RCNN algorithm. To address the challenges in detecting abnormalities within the human eye suffering from. Diabetic retinopathy which is a multi-stage disease prevalent in long-standing diabetes, complicates diagnosis due to its intricate nature. A total of 20 data set images were taken from Kaggle databases and subjected to the Fast RCNN algorithm to detect the efficiency of prediction. The results indicated a modal loss of 0.6 and an accuracy of 89.9. The training and testing models were able to converge after 12 epochs indicating the efficient prediction after applying deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: Enhance the Context-Based Online Recommendation System using Deep Reccurrent Neural Network with Enhaned Pigeon Search Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Most research in the area of Recommendation Systems (RS) seeks to improve quality by applying multiple methodologies. The main objective is to improve predictive performance while disregarding other design objectives, including the environment of a patient’s article. As a result, at numerous levels, a learning-based RS was proposed in this research. It is an efficient RS to improve the smallest amount of error during suggestion. The information started with the Python framework. Following preprocessing, the Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) algorithm was used to present the extracted and contextual information from each preprocessing evaluation. The resulting characteristics were used as an entry for density-based clustering, which groups client evaluations into negative, neutral and favourable attitudes. Each item had an uncertain chance of being appreciated by a customer. The effectiveness of the recommendation system was measured according to its regrets, using an Oracle method that would know the probability of a benchmark. The hybrid Deep Recurring Neural Network- Enhanced Pigeon Search Optimization (DRNN-EPSO) method has been used to initialize the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) modeling input variables. Also, the article used RNN, logistic regression, Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and other supervised learning methods. Our study indicates the weighting factor of the various components of disappointment (i) the element emerging from the restriction of not trying to present the very same product to the very same consumer 2 times, (ii) the element emerging from having to learn the opportunities consumers like goods, & lastly the element emerging from having to learn the internal structure. The proposed model’s performance was measured using correctness, specificity, & recall measures, and it is contrasted latest systems. The proposed model has an average accuracy of $99.6 \%$, which would be more accurate than previous machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Connectivity and Data Processing in IoT Ecosystems through Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This work, which explores the performance of the existing five IoT sensor classification algorithms and develops five more algorithms, intends to later compare the obtained classification accuracies. In this evaluation, the algorithms included are Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors, Support Vector Machine, and Naive Bayes, while the proposed ones are called EdgeNet, IoTBoost, EdgeSVM, DeepEdge, and EdgeFusionNet. The performances are evaluated using the key measures of precision and processing time. Results show that the algorithms under study are usually more accurate than well-known ones, with EdgeFusionNet reaching 94% accuracy which is the highest accuracy. In the selection of algorithms, existing ones show different performance but the Decision Tree and Naive Bayes demonstrate relatively faster processing times compared to the Random Forest and the Support Vector Machine. Yet, the proposed EdgeSVM algorithm shows almost the fastest processing time which exceeds Zokfl2 and other algorithms onference. On top of that, extra measures comprise memory usage, energy efficiency, scalability, model size, and robustness are evaluated for the suggested algorithms. Thus, the results may be inferred that the suggested algorithms provide the advanced solutions for the IoT sensor data classification, that have higher accuracy and comparable or better time complexity in comparison with the existing ones. These outcomes give useful information for researchers as well as technicians that using IoT techniques for the sake of various applications purposes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Stockpile Management Through Deep Learning with a Focus on Demand Forecasting and Inventory Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Stockpile management is essential for industries to efficiently meet customer demands while minimizing costs. Traditional methods like the Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) model and ARIMA often struggle with adaptability and accuracy, leading to inefficiencies such as overstocking or stockouts. This study proposes using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to improve demand forecasting in stockpile management. LSTMs are designed to handle sequential data, capturing complex patterns and long-term dependencies that conventional methods miss. The LSTM-based approach achieved up to a $\mathbf{0. 3 0 \%}$ improvement in forecasting accuracy, resulting in more precise inventory control and better alignment with actual demand. The proposed system, termed Deep Inventory Management (DIM), incorporates LSTM models that adapt to changes in demand by considering factors such as seasonality and trends. This adaptive approach allows for proactive inventory predictions, enhancing decision-making in procurement and stock levels. Key abbreviations include LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory), EOQ (Economic Order Quantity), and DIM (Deep Inventory Management). By aligning inventory more closely with demand, this deep learning approach enhances operational efficiency, reduces costs, and improves customer satisfaction, making it a valuable advancement over traditional inventory management methods.

articleTitle: Securing IoT Environments from Botnets: An Advanced Intrusion Detection Framework Using TJO-Based Feature Selection an d Tree Growth Algorithm-Enhanced LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Concerns about cyberattacks are on the rise in the modern digital era, particularly with the expansion of the Internet of Things (IoT). Protecting IoT environments from harmful behaviour requires cybersecurity intrusion detection solutions. The ever-changing nature of infections and the proliferation of attack routes make botnet identification a formidable challenge. Numerous network devices have been targeted by botnet assaults, resulting in significant losses across several industries, due to the fast development of the IoT. Threats posed by botnets to network security are real, and deep learning models have demonstrated promise in efficiently detecting botnet activity in data collected from network traffic. Because of their remarkable capacity to autonomously discover intricate patterns and characteristics inside massive datasets. Unfortunately, the increasingly diverse nature of IoT ecosystems is rendering ineffective the traditional network-level intrusion detection solutions that rely on pre-defined rule sets. A framework to address this issue is presented in this study. When determining if a dataset is suitable for use in transfer learning, our suggested methodology encourages using that dataset as the source domain. The attributes that are most relevant are selected from the pre-processed data using Tom and Jerry Optimiser (TJO). Next, the prediction procedure makes use of Optimised Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM), with Tree Growth Algorithm (TGA) taking LSTM fine-tuning into account. The purpose of this selection procedure is to ascertain whether or not the suggested model is suitable for implementation, providing the optimal course of action in such cases. By selecting an appropriate source domain data set, our evaluation shows that the suggested framework achieves the best accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity in Modern Networks: A Low-Complexity NIDS Framework using Lightweight SRNN Model Tuned with Coot and Lion Swarm Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The tremendous increase in internet-based traffic has put modern networks at risk from numerous threats. The effective functioning of network infrastructure is impeded by invasive traffic, which uses up resources and time. Increased output is the result of a well-planned approach to avoiding, identifying, and dealing with intrusion situations. When it comes to cybersecurity, intrusion detection systems (IDS) are important for keeping networks safe from all sorts of malicious cyberattacks. Finding highly adaptive, small-footprint Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) that can detect anomalies is the urgent need of this research. The research makes use of the comprehensive NSL-KDD dataset, which includes 43 variables labelled “attack” and “level.” It suggests a new method for intrusion detection that combines Deep Learning models based on feature selection. Coot Optimiser efficiently chooses the most important characteristics, while the Sliced Recurrent Neural Network (SRNN) model detects threats. Lion Swarm Optimisation Algorithm (LSOA) reduces computing complexity by properly tuning the SRNN’s fine-tuning parameters. In addition, the proposed intrusion detection approach may be more easily evaluated with this dataset. In addition, the main objective of this effort is to expand detection accuracy while retaining operating efficiency. A typical NIDS also uses a number of methods to look at both normal and dangerous behaviour. Our proposed strategy is shown to improve intrusion detection precision, which is a significant step forward in this area, according to the results. To combat increasing cyberthreats and adapt to evolving network conditions, our next steps will centre on fortifying and broadening our strategy.

articleTitle: Smart Grid Solar Tracking Optimization using Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The integration of solar power into smart grids necessitates efficient solar tracking to maximize energy capture. Conventional methods like Single-Axis Trackers (SAT) and Dual-Axis Trackers (DAT) have limitations, including high maintenance costs, limited adaptability, and inefficiency under variable weather conditions. These drawbacks result in suboptimal energy generation, hindering the performance of smart grids. The proposed Smart Grid Solar Tracking Optimization using Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm (SGST-DRLA) addresses these issues by utilizing a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) approach to dynamically optimize solar panel orientation. Unlike static control strategies of SAT and DAT, SGST-DRLA continuously learns from realtime data, adjusting the tracker’s position to maximize sunlight exposure and energy capture. This adaptive method enhances tracking precision and reduces operational costs. SGST-DRLA significantly improves performance metrics, achieving a $0.25 \%$ increase in energy capture efficiency, a $\mathbf{0. 2 0 \%}$ reduction in operational costs, and a $\mathbf{0. 3 0 \%}$ improvement in adaptability to varying weather conditions compared to traditional methods. This approach not only optimizes solar tracking in smart grids but also supports sustainable and efficient renewable energy integration, making it a viable solution for overcoming the limitations of existing tracking systems.

articleTitle: Dynamic Malware Analysis and Node Behavior Monitoring with Self-Replication for Enhanced Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Cyber-attacks target another individual or organization’s technological infrastructure. When several activities undermine the accessibility, privacy, or reliability of a computer system resource, a compromise is detected. Intrusion Detection Systems warn management stations when they identify unusual network or system activities, such as security policy violations. Cyber networks send too much data for real-time detection of threats. The project focuses on detecting cyber threats using artificial neural networks. Checking user behavior for abnormalities may help spot fraud. How systems can detect new vulnerabilities and respond to mitigate or eliminate threats is a major cyber security topic. Detecting unfriendly nodes before they can interact prevents cyber assaults, requiring sophisticated safety measures. A self- replication technique for spotting network breaches using dynamically intrusion pattern identification and quick node activity analysis is proposed in this paper. This paradigm reduces false positives in highly dynamic systems with frequent behavior changes. Dynamic malware analysis and node behavior may properly identify malware. Alerts given when anything risky happens allow instantaneous delivery of solutions to other systems and avoidance of assaults on various systems. The self-healing technology protects the network against malicious applications. The healing themselves model protects the system from infections by malware and information loss with $98 \%$ accuracy, while the proposed model analyzes patterns dynamically with $\mathbf{9 8. 4 \%}$ accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimizing Hyperspectral Image Enhancement with FPGA Hardware Accelerators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Hyperspectral image processing plays a crucial role in various applications, including remote sensing and agricultural monitoring, yet it poses significant computational challenges due to the high dimensionality and intricate data structures involved. Traditional software-based methods often suffer from high processing time and latency, limiting their effectiveness in real-time applications. To address these challenges, we propose a hardware accelerator implemented on the Genesys 2 Kintex-7 FPGA Development Board, designed specifically for hyperspectral image enhancement. This FPGA-based solution employs parallel processing and optimized algorithms, including interpolation and super-resolution techniques, to significantly improve processing efficiency. We evaluate the performance of our proposed method using the Indian Pines dataset, a standard benchmark for hyperspectral imaging. Experimental results demonstrate that our FPGA implementation achieves a processing time of 50 ms, significantly faster than CPU and GPU solutions, while also reducing power consumption and improving energy efficiency. These findings underscore the potential of FPGA technology for enhancing hyperspectral image processing in resource-constrained environments.

articleTitle: Sustainable Machine Learning for Real-Time DDoS Attack Detection and Mitigation in Industry 4.0 CPS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Industry 4.0, often known as the “Fourth Industrial Revolution,” has remodelled factories into “Sustainable Cyber-Physical Production Systems” (CPPSs) that connect workers, tools, and completed products. Benefits from digitization include introducing customer-centric, transparent, and adaptable production methods. However, it has also created new attack vectors, with malicious actors taking advantage of network security gaps and focusing on IoT devices. The intricate nature of Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) assaults endangers production lines, corporate operations, and workers in today’s dynamic industrial context. To address these issues sustainably, this study employs Machine Learning (ML) to identify network anomalies and construct data-driven models for DDoS attack detection in Industry 4.0 CPPSs. Unlike previous methods, these use actual data collected from a semiconductor manufacturing facility’s network. During training, 45 aspects of network flow are extracted in both directions, and various labeled datasets are curated. Eleven distinct forms of monitoring strategies for supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised machine learning settings are examined in detail in this paper. The simulations’ accuracy indicates the efficacy of supervised algorithms, which are demonstrated to work with both loose and stringent supervision for detection. The Decision Tree model, for instance, achieves an outstanding $\mathbf{0 . 9 9 9}$ Accuracy and a truly remarkable $\mathbf{0 . 0 0 1 \%}$ False Positive Rate. In the face of increasing cyber threats, this long-term, sustainable strategy to cybersecurity in Industry 4.0 strengthens CPPSs’ resilience and security.

Index Terms: Distributed Denial Of Service Attack Detection

articleTitle: Optimizing Drug-Target Interaction Predictions for Anti-Cancer Agents Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: It is necessary to develop more personalized treatments for cancer patients since their reactions to cancer drugs vary. Researchers are seeking alternatives to clinical trials to help speed up the process of discovering new drugs. The cancer and pharmacogenomics industries have been propelled by big data. Data mining and AI are crucial for making sense of the information and driving changes in cancer therapy. Achieving the desired effect requires structural and functional drug-tissue and drug-tissue-gene expression similarity. To address class-imbalanced data, this study proposes a bagging-based ensembles framework called BE-DTI for drug targeted interaction forecasting. The system makes use of reducing dimensionality and active learning. Oversampling bagging-based compositions may be enhanced by active learning. Dealing with data that has a lot of dimensions requires dimensionality reduction. With respect to AUC, specificity, sensitivity, and Gmean, the suggested approach beats out every one of the five competitive techniques in a 10 -fold cross-validation experiment. The suggested system is able to anticipate both new and missing connections. Both the class imbalances and the large dimensionality of the information are addressed by the suggested approach. The suggested method uses a method known as active learning to enhance the forecasting of compositions using bagging. In addition, the suggested framework undergoes a sensitivity study to examine the impact of parameters. According to the findings, the suggested BE-DTI and BE-DTI’ models performed the most effectively, with BEDTI’ scoring 96.54 and BE-DTI 94.26. Both of these models perform well across numerous criteria, confirming their quality.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi Camera-Based Leaf Pest Detection By Using Classical Image Processing With CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This research describes the creation of a sophisticated system that combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with traditional image processing methods to identify pests and illnesses on plant leaves. The primary goal is to increase agricultural output by facilitating early identification and offering prompt treatment suggestions, which will lower crop losses. The system initially employs traditional image processing methods to identify the edges of leaves, improve image contrast, and detect anomalies such as black spots, pests, and other foreign objects. These methods utilize various techniques, including color space conversion (from BGR to HSV), adaptive thresholding, morphological operations, and contour detection, which help the system isolate and highlight potential problem areas on the leaf. Although these traditional methods are effective, they have limitations in accurately detecting complex patterns, especially under varying lighting conditions and across different leaf types. To address these difficulties, the project incorporates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), which are advanced machine learning models that can autonomously acquire and extract characteristics from large collections of leaf pictures. The CNN model is trained on a comprehensive dataset that includes photos of both healthy and sick leaves. Data augmentation methods are used to enhance its resilience. The model’s architecture comprises convolutional layers for feature extraction, pooling layers for dimensionality reduction, and fully connected layers for detection. A comparative analysis between the CNN-based approach and traditional image processing methods demonstrates significant enhancements in accuracy, robustness, and scalability. The CNN model is particularly effective in identifying even subtle disease patterns and pests, offering a more adaptable and thorough solution for real-time leaf disease detection. This system is valuable for farmers, facilitating early intervention and more effective pest and disease management in crops.

articleTitle: Face Recognition and Detection using CNN and Cascade Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Face biometrics has been used extensively in various spheres of the current technological world due to its high accuracy and non-intrusive nature. In this study, we present a comprehensive system built, leveraging the power of Cascade Detector and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for accurate and efficient face detection and recognition, with a specific focus on individuals of Asian ethnicity. The face detection component employs a Cascade Detector to identify key facial features, including the eyes, nose, and mouth. Simultaneously, we utilize three prominent CNN models, namely AlexNet, SqueezeNet, and GoogleNet, for recognizing faces in RGB images. Additionally, a custom-built CNN model is employed for grayscale images, enhancing the versatility of the system across different imaging scenarios. The models are trained on a diverse dataset that includes individuals of Asian ethnicity, enabling the system to excel in recognizing facial features unique to this demographic. Evaluation metrics including Accuracy, False Acceptance Rate (FAR) and False Rejection Rate (FRR) were computed across diverse datasets, facilitating a comprehensive analysis of model performance. Among the colour datasets, the Indian female dataset consistently yielded the highest accuracy, ranging from 65% to 95%, while the Southeast Asian dataset exhibited comparatively lower accuracy, ranging from 40% to 60%. The Indian male dataset fell within the range of 55% to 75% accuracy, grayscale datasets, our custom-built CNN model achieved impressive accuracies of 92.68%.

articleTitle: Optimizing Power and Data Routing in Wireless Sensor Networks: A Focus on Enhancing Network Lifetime
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: The historical backdrop of sensor organizes innovation begins in the principal appropriated detecting thought executions. The nonstop work of analysts and specialists over sensor systems which recently became wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Wireless sensor networks are one of the developing innovations for detecting and performing various undertakings. Such systems are gainful in numerous fields, for example, crises, health monitoring, environmental control, military, businesses and these systems are not extremely effective in battery optimization and data routing. Network lifetime is a major necessity for these systems. In this report, our focal point of consideration is on Power optimization and issues in wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Integrating Remote Sensing Technologies for Real-Time Disaster Management, Mitigation, and Decision Support Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: This study provides a detailed understanding of methodologies on how to apply remote sensing technologies, predictive modeling, DSS in disaster management and mitigation. Using satellite images, aerial maps, and remote sensors, the system gathers data for real-time monitoring of, and real-time assessment of the probability of, natural disasters including hurricanes, earthquakes, floods, and wildfire. Disaster prediction has utilized Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Neural Networks models where accuracy was ranging from ${8 7 \%}$. $8 \%$ and $93.5 \%$. This insight was made possible by the DSS that helped in decision making processes, particularly response to disasters and distribution of resources, optimal evacuation plans. Satellite and drone data provided features for real-time monitoring proving the ability for swift detection, which improved the response effectiveness. The optical, radar, and thermal imaging technologies reached the accuracy of over $94 \%$ in post-earthquake damage assessment, which helped in targeting the rescue operations effectively. The developed system is also highly extensible and can be scaled depending on the chosen picture of future disasters, as well as updated as new solutions in field of remote sensing and machine learning appear. The results provide evidence of the effectiveness of the offered system to improve the corresponding disaster preparedness, response, and recovery for further enabling better practices regarding disaster management and fewer associated consequences.

articleTitle: Multimodal Approach to Decoding Facial Expressions Using LBPH and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Advances in Science and Engineering Technology (ICRASET)
abstract: Human emotions are essential for communication, and identifying them is critical for fields like mental health monitoring and human-computer interaction. Emotions are primarily communicated through facial expressions. There are several ways to identify emotions. Using a multimodal and hybrid method, the suggested model combines statistical data and picture attributes with an image dataset. Following face recognition using LBPH, photos are classified using machine learning and deep learning techniques, and the final result is predicted using ensemble learning on an Indian image dataset. The model detects seven emotions with an overall accuracy of 85.29%.
